categories.description: Virtual camera moves, lens behavior and shutter: how the frame itself travels and sees.
Easing curves, spring stiffness/damping values and the classic animation principles applied to code.
Beat grids, holds, staggers and pacing that make picture and sound feel composed.
Ways to get from one shot to the next, each with exact duration and easing.
Kinetic type mechanisms, type scale and masking rules for on-screen text.
Framing, grids, hierarchy and reflow across 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16.
Lighting setups and surface materials built in shaders or Canvas2D, no photo assets.
Palettes, perceptual color math, tonemapping and the final grade pass.
Grain, dither, vignette, edges and finishing passes that survive video encoding.
Animated charts and numbers that stay honest while they move.
Simulated product interfaces: cursors, taps, sheets, lists and state changes.
Parallax, projection, raymarching and 3D staging with WebGL or 2.5D Canvas.
Seeded particle systems, noise fields and simulations that render deterministically.
Web Audio recipes for hits, risers, beds and mastering, rendered offline.
Beat structures for 6/15/30/60-second launch films and the moments inside them.
Determinism, seam, legibility, contrast, overlap, phone and contact-sheet checks before delivery.
Common giveaways of default machine-made video, each paired with its exact fix.

entries.definition: Camera holds perfectly still so only the subject moves; motion reads as intentional and type stays crisp.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera transform fixed for the full 3.0 s shot; only the product rotates 12° on Y with inOutSine.
entries.best_for: Hero product reveals, end cards, legal lines
entries.pitfalls: Feels dead if the subject also barely moves.
entries.native_impl: Keep the view matrix constant; animate model matrix only.

entries.definition: Camera physically moves toward the subject, enlarging it while perspective between near and far layers shifts.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera dollies in from z=10 to z=8.6 over 4.0 s, inOutSine, subject centered, background layers scale 4% less than foreground.
entries.best_for: Building tension before a headline or price
entries.pitfalls: Too fast reads as a zoom; keep under 15% size change per 4 s.
entries.native_impl: WebGL: lerp camera.position.z; Canvas2D: per-layer scale by 1/depth.

entries.definition: Camera retreats from subject to reveal surrounding context or scale.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera pulls back from 1.25x to 1.00x framing over 3.5 s, outCubic, revealing 3 surrounding cards by 2.0 s.
entries.best_for: Context reveals, 'it's bigger than you think' beats
entries.pitfalls: Revealed area must already be composed, not empty.
entries.native_impl: Animate camera distance; pre-place context elements outside initial frustum.

entries.definition: Camera slides sideways parallel to the subject plane, producing parallax between depth layers.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera trucks left 6% of frame width over 5 s, linear, foreground layer moves 1.6x, background 0.4x.
entries.best_for: Feature rows, timelines, showing several devices in sequence
entries.pitfalls: Linear speed with hard start/stop looks robotic; ease the ends 300 ms.
entries.native_impl: Translate each layer by camDx * (1/depth).

entries.definition: Camera rises or lowers vertically without tilting, keeping horizon lines parallel.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera pedestals up 120 px over 2.4 s, inOutQuad, horizon stays level, title enters from below frame at 1.2 s.
entries.best_for: Revealing a stack, rising from detail to overview
entries.pitfalls: Combining with tilt breaks the clean architectural feel.
entries.native_impl: Animate camera.position.y and target.y by the same amount.

entries.definition: Camera rotates around its vertical axis, sweeping the view left or right from a fixed position.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera pans 18° right over 3.0 s, inOutSine, no parallax between layers because the pivot is the lens.
entries.best_for: Scanning a wide scene or a panoramic UI
entries.pitfalls: Fast pans strobe at 30 fps; keep below 30°/s or add motion blur.
entries.native_impl: Rotate view matrix about Y at camera position.

entries.definition: Camera rotates on its horizontal axis, sweeping the view up or down from a fixed point.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera tilts up 10° over 2.0 s, outQuart, ending with the headline at 38% from top.
entries.best_for: Revealing tall objects, looking up to a hero
entries.pitfalls: Large tilts converge verticals; under 15° stays natural.
entries.native_impl: Rotate view matrix about camera-local X.

entries.definition: Field of view narrows or widens without moving the camera, magnifying everything uniformly with no parallax.
entries.prompt_phrase: Field of view narrows from 50° to 38° over 2.5 s, inOutCubic, camera position fixed.
entries.pitfalls: Reads cheaper than a dolly on 3D scenes; flattens depth.
entries.native_impl: Animate perspective fovy; Canvas2D: uniform scale about frame center.

entries.definition: Camera dollies while FOV changes oppositely, so the subject stays fixed size while background perspective stretches or compresses.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera dollies from z=6 to z=12 over 2.0 s while FOV narrows to keep the subject at exactly 40% frame height; inOutSine.
entries.best_for: Moment of realization, dramatic product focus
entries.pitfalls: Needs strong background depth cues or effect is invisible.
entries.native_impl: fov = 2*atan(subjectHeight/(2*dist*frac)); recompute each frame.

entries.definition: Camera circles the subject at a constant radius while staying aimed at it, showing multiple sides.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera orbits 40° around the product at radius 5 over 6 s, inOutSine, elevation fixed at 12°.
entries.pitfalls: Full 360° loops feel like a configurator; 30-60° feels cinematic.
entries.native_impl: pos = target + r*(sin θ, h, cos θ); lookAt(target).

entries.definition: Camera rises and tilts down simultaneously, revealing a layout from above.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera cranes up 2.5 units while pitching from 0° to -35° over 3.5 s, inOutCubic, grid of 12 tiles revealed by 2.8 s.
entries.pitfalls: Tilt and rise must share one easing curve or the move wobbles.
entries.native_impl: Interpolate camera y and pitch with the same eased t.

entries.definition: Focus shifts from one depth plane to another, transferring attention without cutting.
entries.prompt_phrase: Focus racks from foreground card (blur 0→8 px) to background title (blur 8→0 px) over 600 ms, inOutSine, starting at 1.4 s.
entries.best_for: Shifting attention between two elements in one frame
entries.pitfalls: Both planes sharp at mid-point looks wrong; crossfade blur amounts.
entries.native_impl: Canvas2D ctx.filter='blur(npx)' per layer; WebGL depth-based gather blur.

entries.definition: Only a thin depth slice is sharp; foreground and background fall into soft circles of confusion.
entries.prompt_phrase: Focus plane at subject depth, blur radius grows 1.2 px per 0.1 depth units, capped at 14 px; highlights bloom into 6-blade discs.
entries.best_for: Premium product stills, isolating a UI element
entries.pitfalls: Blurring text the viewer must read; blur cap too high looks fake.
entries.native_impl: WebGL: CoC from depth buffer, 16-tap disc gather; Canvas: pre-blurred layers.

entries.definition: Narrow field of view flattens depth so distant objects appear stacked close behind the subject.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use FOV 18° with camera distance 22 units so the 5 background panels stack tightly behind the product, size ratio under 1.3x.
entries.pitfalls: Small camera moves become huge on screen; keep orbits under 8°.
entries.native_impl: Perspective fovy=18°, push camera back to keep framing.

entries.definition: Wide field of view exaggerates depth: near objects loom large and lines converge strongly.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use FOV 75° with camera 2.2 units from the hero object so it fills 55% of frame and edges converge visibly.
entries.pitfalls: Edge stretching distorts text and faces; keep type near center.
entries.native_impl: Perspective fovy=70-80°, camera close to subject.

entries.definition: Subtle low-frequency noise on camera position and rotation that suggests a living operator without shake.
entries.prompt_phrase: Add camera drift from 2-octave value noise at 0.15 Hz, amplitude 0.4% of frame width and 0.25° roll, seeded per shot.
entries.best_for: Calm holds that must not feel frozen
entries.pitfalls: High-frequency jitter reads as error; never above 1 Hz.
entries.native_impl: offset = amp * noise1D(seed + t*0.15); deterministic from frame time.

entries.definition: Camera rolled around its lens axis so horizon is diagonal, creating unease or energy.
entries.prompt_phrase: Roll the camera 7° clockwise for the 1.2 s glitch beat, then settle to 0° over 400 ms outBack(1.2).
entries.pitfalls: Keeping it on headlines hurts legibility; use on imagery only.
entries.native_impl: Rotate the view or the root canvas transform about frame center.

entries.definition: Extremely fast pan that smears the frame into directional blur, often hiding a cut.
entries.prompt_phrase: Whip pan right over 8 frames at 30 fps: horizontal blur peaks at 6% of frame width on frame 4, cut hidden at peak.
entries.pitfalls: Without motion blur it strobes; always render smear.
entries.native_impl: Accumulate 8-12 subframes or apply directional blur shader along pan axis.

entries.definition: Abrupt fast zoom onto a detail with a hard stop, often with a slight overshoot.
entries.prompt_phrase: Scale 1.0→2.4 over 180 ms outExpo onto the stat, overshoot 3% and settle in 120 ms, 2-frame radial blur during the move.
entries.best_for: Punchline numbers, comedic or high-energy emphasis
entries.pitfalls: More than twice per 30 s becomes tiring.
entries.native_impl: Canvas2D setTransform scale about target point; radial blur via stacked draws.

entries.definition: Fraction of each frame interval the virtual shutter is open; controls motion blur length.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render with 180° shutter: average 8 subframes spanning the first half of each 1/30 s frame interval.
entries.best_for: Any fast motion; making code renders feel filmed
entries.pitfalls: 360° looks smeary; 45° looks staccato and jittery.
entries.native_impl: Render N subframes at t + k*(shutter/360)/fps/N and average in float buffer.

entries.definition: Camera looks straight down onto a flat arrangement, turning the scene into a graphic layout.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera pitched -90°, orthographic, 9 cards arranged on a 3x3 grid with 4% gutters, slow 3° rotation over 6 s.
entries.pitfalls: Pure top-down removes depth; add soft drop shadows offset 0.
entries.native_impl: Orthographic projection with camera.up set to -Z.

entries.definition: Camera below the subject looking up, making it feel large and powerful.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera at 15% frame height below the product's base, pitched up 14°, product top touches 12% from frame top.
entries.pitfalls: Floor plane must be clean or shows rendering gaps.
entries.native_impl: Place camera y below target, lookAt(target), FOV 40-50°.

entries.definition: Emulates squeezed-lens traits: horizontal streak flares, oval bokeh, wide aspect.
entries.prompt_phrase: Bokeh discs scaled 0.6x horizontally, highlights over 0.9 luminance get a 1-px-tall horizontal streak 40% of frame wide at 30% opacity.
entries.pitfalls: Overused streaks look cheap; limit to 1-2 light sources.
entries.native_impl: Threshold bright pass, blur 1D horizontally only, add back at low opacity.

entries.definition: Camera arrives at its final framing with a tiny damped overshoot instead of a dead stop.
entries.prompt_phrase: Camera move ends with spring settle: stiffness 120, damping 18, overshoot under 1.5% of travel, rest within 450 ms.
entries.best_for: Ending any camera move on a hold
entries.pitfalls: Visible bounce on camera makes viewers seasick.
entries.native_impl: Critically-under-damped spring integrated with fixed dt from frame index.

entries.definition: Value changes at a constant rate with no acceleration; mechanical and continuous.
entries.prompt_phrase: Ticker strip scrolls left at a constant 90 px/s linear for the whole 8 s shot, no ease at the ends because it never stops on screen.
entries.best_for: Infinite scrolls, rotating loaders, progress fills tied to time
entries.pitfalls: Using it for moves that start or stop on screen.
entries.native_impl: v = a + (b-a)*t.

entries.definition: Very soft symmetrical acceleration and deceleration based on a half cosine.
entries.prompt_phrase: Background gradient drifts 8% across the frame over 6 s, inOutSine.
entries.best_for: Ambient drifts, camera breathing, slow parallax
entries.pitfalls: Too soft for UI arrivals; feels sluggish under 400 ms.

entries.definition: Starts fast and decelerates to rest; the default for elements arriving on screen.
entries.prompt_phrase: Card slides up 48 px and fades 0→1 over 420 ms outCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Using it for exits; exits should accelerate (inCubic).

entries.definition: Stronger deceleration than cubic; most of the travel happens in the first third.
entries.prompt_phrase: Headline slides in 120 px over 600 ms outQuart, 80% of travel done by 220 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Long tail can look like the element is still drifting.

entries.definition: Exponential deceleration: explosive start, very long gentle settle; signature of crisp launch typography.
entries.prompt_phrase: Words rise 40 px from behind a baseline mask, 60 ms stagger, 520 ms outExpo, hold 1.2 s.
entries.best_for: Kinetic type, big reveals, hero numbers
entries.pitfalls: Last 30% is almost motionless; trim duration accordingly.

entries.definition: Slow start, violent middle, slow finish; makes moves feel like a cut with motion.
entries.prompt_phrase: Panel swaps position over 700 ms inOutExpo so the middle 200 ms carries 80% of the travel.
entries.pitfalls: Mid-move frames need motion blur or they skip.

entries.definition: Starts slow and accelerates away; correct for elements leaving the frame.
entries.prompt_phrase: Old caption exits down 30 px and fades out over 260 ms inCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Using it for entrances makes them crash into position.
entries.native_impl: e = t*t*t.

entries.definition: Decelerates past the target then returns, giving a small overshoot.
entries.prompt_phrase: Icon scales 0→1 over 480 ms outBack with overshoot constant 1.4 (peaks at about 1.08x).
entries.pitfalls: Overshoot above 1.7 looks cartoony; never on body text.

entries.definition: Briefly moves backward before accelerating forward; built-in anticipation.
entries.prompt_phrase: Arrow pulls back 6% then launches right over 450 ms inBack (s=1.7).
entries.best_for: Exits with intent, buttons launching away
entries.pitfalls: Combined with outBack at both ends feels rubbery.

entries.definition: Overshoots and oscillates with decaying amplitude before resting.
entries.prompt_phrase: Notification dot scales to 1.0 with outElastic, period 0.35, amplitude 1.0, total 900 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Seasickness and cheapness when used on large surfaces.

entries.definition: Simulates a rigid object hitting a floor and bouncing with decaying height.
entries.prompt_phrase: Coin drops 200 px onto the shelf with outBounce over 800 ms, 3 bounces visible.
entries.pitfalls: Wrong for premium tone; looks like a template preset.
entries.native_impl: Piecewise parabola segments at 1/2.75, 2/2.75, 2.5/2.75.

entries.definition: Easing defined by two control points so velocity profile can be tuned exactly.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all entrances, 500 ms; exits use cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.84, 0), 300 ms.
entries.best_for: Locking one house motion signature across a film
entries.pitfalls: Control x values outside 0..1 are invalid.
entries.native_impl: Solve x(t) by Newton iteration then evaluate y; or CSS transition-timing-function.

entries.definition: Physics spring with damping exactly sufficient to stop without overshoot; fastest clean settle.
entries.prompt_phrase: Panel moves with spring mass 1, stiffness 170, damping 26 (zeta 1.0), settles under 0.5 px in 420 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Durations vary with distance; budget timeline from simulation.
entries.native_impl: x'' = -k(x-target) - c x'; semi-implicit Euler at 1/240 s substeps.

entries.definition: Stiff spring with light overshoot that feels responsive and precise.
entries.prompt_phrase: Toggle knob uses spring stiffness 400, damping 28, mass 1: overshoot about 4%, settled by 280 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Stiffness above 600 at 30 fps aliases; substep the integrator.
entries.native_impl: Same integrator, k=400, c=28, fixed substeps per frame.

entries.definition: Low-damping spring with visible oscillations before rest.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sticker lands with spring stiffness 220, damping 10, mass 1: 2 visible oscillations, rest by 900 ms.
entries.pitfalls: On text or charts it reads as a bug.
entries.native_impl: k=220, c=10; clamp after |v|<0.01 and |x-target|<0.1.

entries.definition: Low-stiffness, well-damped spring producing a slow, floaty arrival.
entries.prompt_phrase: Background shapes drift into place with spring stiffness 60, damping 14, mass 1, about 1.1 s to rest.
entries.pitfalls: Too slow for foreground; viewers wait for it.

entries.definition: Animation principle: a small opposite move before the main action signals what is coming.
entries.prompt_phrase: Before the card flies right, it dips 8 px left over 120 ms inOutSine, then travels 600 px over 380 ms outExpo.
entries.pitfalls: Anticipation longer than the action stalls rhythm.
entries.native_impl: Two-segment keyframe track; or inBack easing.

entries.definition: Animation principle: parts of an object stop at different times, trailing the main body.
entries.prompt_phrase: Card body stops at 400 ms; its label stops 70 ms later and its shadow 120 ms later, each outCubic.
entries.best_for: Multi-part UI cards, logos with sub-elements
entries.pitfalls: Excess lag makes elements look disconnected.
entries.native_impl: Offset start/end times per child; or chain springs with lower stiffness.

entries.definition: Animation principle: an object deforms along its motion while keeping area constant, conveying elasticity and speed.
entries.prompt_phrase: Dot stretches to scaleY 1.25, scaleX 0.8 at peak speed and squashes to 1.2x0.83 on impact for 3 frames.
entries.pitfalls: Unequal area change makes the object look inflated.
entries.native_impl: scaleX = 1/scaleY; scale aligned to velocity direction via rotate.

entries.definition: Animation principle: natural movement follows curved paths rather than straight lines.
entries.prompt_phrase: Icon travels from bottom-left to center along a quadratic arc with control point 18% above the chord, 600 ms outCubic.
entries.best_for: Objects tossed between positions, hand-off moves
entries.pitfalls: Arc too high reads as a jump.
entries.native_impl: Quadratic Bezier position B(e(t)); or separate x/y easings.

entries.definition: Animation principle: motion clusters frames near start and end poses, accelerating through the middle.
entries.prompt_phrase: All position keys use inOutCubic over 500-800 ms; no linear segments except continuous scrolls.
entries.best_for: Default for any A-to-B move both starting and ending on screen
entries.pitfalls: Applied to exits leaving frame wastes time.

entries.definition: Animation principle: smaller motion that supports the main action without competing.
entries.prompt_phrase: As the phone rises 60 px, its reflection sweeps across the screen 400 ms later at 20% opacity.
entries.best_for: Adding richness to a hero move
entries.pitfalls: Secondary louder than primary splits attention.
entries.native_impl: Separate track keyed to the primary action's end time.

entries.definition: Animation principle: amplify motion beyond realism so it reads clearly at speed and small size.
entries.prompt_phrase: Scale pulse peaks at 1.12x instead of 1.03x, 240 ms outBack, so it reads on a 6-inch phone.
entries.best_for: Social cuts viewed small, fast beats
entries.pitfalls: Exaggerating everything removes contrast.
entries.native_impl: Multiply delta values by 2-4x for key accents only.

entries.definition: Motion that starts at a velocity and decays exponentially, like a flicked scroll.
entries.prompt_phrase: List flings with initial velocity 2400 px/s and friction 0.92 per frame at 60 fps, stopping after about 900 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Frame-rate-dependent friction breaks determinism; use time-based decay.
entries.native_impl: x = x0 + v0*(1 - exp(-k t))/k with k chosen from duration.

entries.definition: Ending one move at the same velocity the next begins with, so chained motions feel like one gesture.
entries.prompt_phrase: Segment A ends at 900 px/s; segment B starts at 900 px/s and decelerates outCubic over 400 ms; no visible hitch at the 1.6 s join.
entries.pitfalls: Mismatched easing at joins causes a visible stutter.
entries.native_impl: Use Hermite splines with shared tangent at the key; or simulate one spring.

entries.definition: A fixed timeline grid derived from tempo so every cut and accent lands on musical subdivisions.
entries.prompt_phrase: Set tempo 120 BPM (500 ms per beat, 15 frames at 30 fps); every cut lands on a beat, every type accent on an eighth (250 ms).
entries.best_for: Any film with a synthesized score
entries.pitfalls: Rounding beats to whole frames drifts; compute from absolute time.
entries.native_impl: beatTime(n) = n*60/bpm; frame = round(beatTime*fps).

entries.definition: A key visual event aligned exactly with the first beat of a bar for maximum impact.
entries.prompt_phrase: Logo snaps to full scale on bar 9 beat 1 (16.0 s at 120 BPM), with the kick sample triggered on the same frame.
entries.best_for: Logo reveals, price drops, title cards
entries.pitfalls: Visual event one frame late feels sloppy; align to audio onset.
entries.native_impl: Schedule audio at ctx time T and drive visual from the same T constant.

entries.definition: Minimum on-screen hold so a viewer can read text, scaled to word count.
entries.prompt_phrase: Hold each line for 0.4 s + 0.25 s per word, minimum 1.2 s after the animation settles.
entries.pitfalls: Counting animation time as reading time.
entries.native_impl: hold = max(1.2, 0.4 + 0.25*words) seconds after settle.

entries.definition: Successive elements start the same animation with a fixed delay, creating a flowing sequence.
entries.prompt_phrase: 6 tiles enter with 50 ms stagger, each 450 ms outCubic, total group duration 700 ms.
entries.best_for: Grids, lists, letters, bars of a chart
entries.pitfalls: Total stagger over 1 s makes the last items feel late.
entries.native_impl: start_i = t0 + i*stagger; clamp group length by reducing stagger.

entries.definition: The rule determining which element animates first: left-to-right, center-out, by distance, or random-seeded.
entries.prompt_phrase: Grid of 24 dots staggers center-out by Euclidean distance, 18 ms per grid unit, 400 ms outQuart each.
entries.pitfalls: Unseeded random order changes between renders.
entries.native_impl: delay = dist(cell, origin)*k; or seeded shuffle index.

entries.definition: A single frame or very short moment of emphasis such as a flash, scale bump or color pop.
entries.prompt_phrase: On the 3.0 s hit, flash a full-frame white at 18% opacity for 2 frames, then decay over 6 frames.
entries.pitfalls: More than one accent per 4 s dulls them all.
entries.native_impl: Opacity curve keyed to frame index, additive blending.

entries.definition: A deliberate moment of near-stillness between busy sections so the viewer can absorb.
entries.prompt_phrase: After the feature montage, hold the empty gradient for 0.8 s with only 1% ambient drift before the headline.
entries.best_for: Before the big reveal, between acts
entries.pitfalls: Rests over 1.5 s on social feel broken.
entries.native_impl: Timeline gap with ambient-only tracks.

entries.definition: Cutting during a movement so the motion carries the eye across the edit.
entries.prompt_phrase: Cut from shot A to shot B at the frame where the card is 40% through its 500 ms slide, continuing the motion in B.
entries.pitfalls: Cutting before motion starts feels jumpy.
entries.native_impl: Place cut at the mid-move frame; both shots share an eased path.

entries.definition: Updating the drawing every second frame (or fewer) for a crisp, handmade cadence.
entries.prompt_phrase: Doodle accents update on twos at 30 fps (15 drawings/s), quantize time with floor(frame/2)*2.
entries.pitfalls: Mixing stepped and smooth layers inconsistently.
entries.native_impl: tq = floor(frame/step)*step/fps; evaluate animation at tq.

entries.definition: Playback speed changes within a shot, e.g. fast-to-slow, to emphasize a moment.
entries.prompt_phrase: Particle burst plays at 1.0x, ramps to 0.2x over 300 ms inOutSine around 2.4 s, holds 0.2x for 600 ms, ramps back.
entries.pitfalls: Code sims must take remapped time, not wall time.
entries.native_impl: Integrate localTime += speed(t)*dt; feed localTime to all animations.

entries.definition: Shots get progressively shorter to build energy toward a climax.
entries.prompt_phrase: Feature cuts last 1.6, 1.2, 0.8, 0.5, 0.5, 0.25 s, all on beat, landing the logo on the downbeat at 6.0 s.
entries.pitfalls: Shots under 250 ms carry no information.
entries.native_impl: Shot list with durations from a geometric series snapped to beats.

entries.definition: Tempo or motion slows toward the end of a sequence, signaling closure.
entries.prompt_phrase: Final 2 s: tempo eases from 120 to 96 BPM, motion durations lengthen 1.3x, last move 900 ms outQuart.
entries.pitfalls: Visual and audio tempo slowing at different rates.
entries.native_impl: Scale timeline with time-warp curve; render audio from the same curve.

entries.definition: Alternating shot or animation durations in a pattern to avoid monotony.
entries.prompt_phrase: Cut pattern 1.5 s, 0.75 s, 0.75 s repeated 3 times, on 120 BPM beats.
entries.pitfalls: Every shot equal length feels robotic.
entries.native_impl: Duration array cycled; snapped to beat grid.

entries.definition: Next element begins entering before the previous one finishes leaving.
entries.prompt_phrase: Outgoing title exits over 300 ms; incoming title starts 150 ms into that exit, 450 ms outExpo.
entries.pitfalls: Both fully visible at once creates collision.
entries.native_impl: startNext = startPrevExit + 0.5*exitDuration.

entries.definition: No element should appear for less time than it takes to perceive it.
entries.prompt_phrase: No graphic element stays on screen under 0.5 s; text under 1.2 s; logos under 1.5 s.
entries.pitfalls: Flash frames of text read as glitches.
entries.native_impl: QA script compares each element's visible interval to its floor.

entries.definition: Next scene's sound begins before its picture, pulling the viewer forward.
entries.prompt_phrase: Next scene's riser starts 400 ms before the visual cut and peaks at the cut frame.
entries.pitfalls: Pre-lap over 1 s confuses cause and effect.
entries.native_impl: Schedule next-scene audio at cutTime - 0.4 in the OfflineAudioContext.

entries.definition: Previous scene's sound continues after the visual cut, smoothing transition.
entries.prompt_phrase: Previous pad tail continues 600 ms past the cut, fading -12 dB with an exponential ramp.
entries.pitfalls: Clashing harmonies between tail and new scene.
entries.native_impl: GainNode.exponentialRampToValueAtTime after cut.

entries.definition: A single list of timestamps that drives both visuals and audio so they cannot drift.
entries.prompt_phrase: Define a cue sheet: title_in 0.5 s, feature_1 3.0 s, swell 13.5 s, logo_hit 14.0 s; visuals and audio both read it.
entries.pitfalls: Hard-coding times in multiple places causes drift.
entries.native_impl: const CUES = {...}; draw(t) and buildAudio() import the same object.

entries.definition: The number of independently moving elements at any moment; controls clarity.
entries.prompt_phrase: Keep at most 3 primary moving elements at once; ambient layers under 5% opacity change per second.
entries.pitfalls: Everything moving at once means nothing reads.
entries.native_impl: Count active tracks per frame in QA; warn above budget.

entries.definition: A visual accent placed between beats to create surprise and groove.
entries.prompt_phrase: Small icons pop on the 'and' of beats 2 and 4 (750 ms and 1750 ms in each 2 s bar at 120 BPM), 200 ms outBack.
entries.pitfalls: Offbeat main events undermine the downbeat hit.
entries.native_impl: Cue times at (n+0.5)*beat.

entries.definition: Grouping beats into musical phrases (usually 4 or 8 bars) and changing scenes on phrase boundaries.
entries.prompt_phrase: At 120 BPM, change scenes every 4 bars (8.0 s) in a 30 s film: intro 0-8, problem 8-16, solution 16-24, end card 24-30.
entries.best_for: Structuring a film around a score
entries.pitfalls: Scene breaks mid-phrase feel accidental.
entries.native_impl: Section start = bar*4*beat; generate music and scenes from the same section list.

entries.definition: Instant change from one shot to the next with no blending frames.
entries.prompt_phrase: Hard cut at 4.0 s on the downbeat; shot B's subject sits within 10% of shot A's subject position.
entries.pitfalls: Cutting between visually unrelated positions makes the eye hunt.
entries.native_impl: if (t < cut) drawA(t) else drawB(t).

entries.definition: Outgoing and incoming frames blend by opacity over a short interval.
entries.prompt_phrase: Crossfade A to B over 400 ms inOutSine centered on 6.0 s.
entries.pitfalls: Mid-point double exposure looks muddy with busy frames.
entries.native_impl: Render both to offscreen canvases; globalAlpha mix.

entries.definition: Outgoing shot fades to black, then incoming fades up from black.
entries.prompt_phrase: Fade A to black over 300 ms inQuad, hold black 4 frames, fade B up over 400 ms outQuad.
entries.pitfalls: Too many dips feel like the film is ending.
entries.native_impl: Black rect with animated alpha over both shots.

entries.definition: A short bright flash bridges two shots and punctuates the change.
entries.prompt_phrase: At the cut, overlay white at 85% for 1 frame, decaying to 0 over 5 frames outQuad.
entries.pitfalls: Flashing above 3 per second risks photosensitivity.
entries.native_impl: Additive white quad, alpha by frame offset.

entries.definition: A straight edge travels across the frame replacing shot A with shot B.
entries.prompt_phrase: Hard-edged wipe left-to-right over 500 ms inOutCubic, edge angled 12°, 2 px accent line in brand color.
entries.pitfalls: Soft edge wider than 10% looks like a mistake.
entries.native_impl: Clip path polygon from eased x; or step() in shader.

entries.definition: Incoming shot appears inside an expanding circle from a chosen point.
entries.prompt_phrase: Circle expands from the button's center to cover the frame diagonal over 600 ms inOutExpo.
entries.best_for: Transition from a tapped UI element
entries.pitfalls: Origin not tied to a meaningful object feels arbitrary.
entries.native_impl: ctx.arc clip with radius = e(t)*hypot(w,h).

entries.definition: A line sweeps around a center point like a clock hand, revealing the new shot.
entries.prompt_phrase: Clock wipe 360° clockwise from 12 o'clock over 700 ms inOutSine.
entries.pitfalls: Feels retro if overused.
entries.native_impl: Canvas arc wedge clip from -PI/2 to -PI/2+2PI*e.

entries.definition: Incoming shot pushes outgoing shot off-frame in the same direction.
entries.prompt_phrase: B pushes A left by 100% frame width over 550 ms inOutExpo with 8-subframe motion blur.
entries.pitfalls: Different easing on A and B leaves a gap.
entries.native_impl: Translate A by -e*w and B by (1-e)*w.

entries.definition: Incoming shot slides over a stationary or slightly receding outgoing shot.
entries.prompt_phrase: B slides up over A in 500 ms outQuart; A scales to 0.94 and darkens 30% beneath.
entries.pitfalls: No shadow on the covering layer flattens depth.
entries.native_impl: Draw A transformed, then B with drop shadow.

entries.definition: Cut between two shots where a shape, color or motion lines up exactly across the cut.
entries.prompt_phrase: Circular gauge in shot A at center, 22% frame width, cuts to circular planet in shot B at identical position and size.
entries.pitfalls: Even 5% misalignment breaks the illusion.
entries.native_impl: Share anchor coordinates between scenes via constants.

entries.definition: One shape continuously transforms into another, carrying the eye between scenes.
entries.prompt_phrase: Square card morphs into the circular avatar over 600 ms inOutCubic, corner radius 0→50%, then the scene expands from it.
entries.pitfalls: Paths with mismatched point counts twist.
entries.native_impl: Resample both paths to N=128 points; lerp; or SDF blend in shader.

entries.definition: Camera zooms into an element until it fills the frame and becomes the next scene.
entries.prompt_phrase: Scale the screen element 1x→12x over 700 ms inExpo; at 60% fill, crossfade to scene B over 6 frames.
entries.best_for: Diving into a screen, app, or detail
entries.pitfalls: Pixelation when scaling raster; render vector or at target resolution.
entries.native_impl: Scene B rendered inside element's rect, scale camera until rect covers frame.

entries.definition: A moving foreground object passes the frame and the new scene appears behind it.
entries.prompt_phrase: A dark bar sweeps across the frame in 400 ms; scene B is revealed in its trailing edge.
entries.best_for: Seamless scene changes in product films
entries.pitfalls: Object too thin reveals the trick.
entries.native_impl: Clip scene B to region behind object's leading edge.

entries.definition: Transition driven by a grayscale map: pixels switch when their map value passes a moving threshold.
entries.prompt_phrase: Luma wipe using a radial-plus-noise map, threshold 0→1 over 800 ms, 4% soft edge.
entries.pitfalls: Unseeded noise maps change every render.
entries.native_impl: Shader: mix(A,B,smoothstep(th-e,th+e,map(uv))).

entries.definition: Outgoing shot blurs out while incoming blurs in, crossfading at peak blur.
entries.prompt_phrase: A blurs 0→20 px over 300 ms, crossfade to B at peak, B un-blurs 20→0 px over 350 ms outCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Blur radius scaled to frame width, not fixed pixels.
entries.native_impl: ctx.filter blur on offscreen canvases; or two-pass Gaussian shader.

entries.definition: Image breaks into growing blocks, swaps, then resolves into the next shot.
entries.prompt_phrase: Block size grows 1→48 px over 250 ms, swap at peak, shrink 48→1 px over 250 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Looks like an error on serious content.
entries.native_impl: Draw to small canvas, scale up with imageSmoothingEnabled=false.

entries.definition: A brand-colored shape expands from a point to fill the frame, then becomes the next background.
entries.prompt_phrase: Brand-color circle bursts from the tapped icon to fill the frame in 450 ms outExpo; next scene's content fades in at 300 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Too many bursts feel like a template.
entries.native_impl: Arc fill radius e*diag; next scene drawn over.

entries.definition: Frame divides into panels showing multiple shots at once, usually animating the dividers.
entries.prompt_phrase: Frame splits into 3 vertical panels, dividers slide in over 500 ms outQuart, 12 px gutters, each panel plays its own shot.
entries.pitfalls: Too many panels on 9:16 become unreadable.
entries.native_impl: Clip each panel rect; draw scenes into clips.

entries.definition: A bright soft band crosses the frame; the cut is hidden at its peak brightness.
entries.prompt_phrase: Warm white band 25% frame width sweeps left-to-right in 500 ms, additive, peak 90% at 250 ms where the cut occurs.
entries.pitfalls: Clipping to pure white loses the shot.
entries.native_impl: Additive linear gradient quad; tonemap after.

entries.definition: Pixels switch from A to B according to a seeded noise field, creating a granular dissolve.
entries.prompt_phrase: Seeded value-noise dissolve over 600 ms, 3 px noise scale, 2% soft edge.
entries.pitfalls: High-frequency noise compresses badly in H.264.
entries.native_impl: Luma wipe using hash(floor(uv*res/3)).

entries.definition: The frame rotates 180° around an axis, revealing the next shot on its back.
entries.prompt_phrase: Frame flips around Y over 700 ms inOutCubic, perspective 1200 px, B drawn when angle passes 90°.
entries.pitfalls: No perspective looks like a squash, not a flip.
entries.native_impl: CSS rotateY with perspective; or WebGL quad with backface swap.

entries.definition: The frame divides into strips that rotate or slide in staggered order to reveal the next shot.
entries.prompt_phrase: 8 horizontal slats slide right with 40 ms stagger, each 400 ms inOutExpo.
entries.pitfalls: Too many slats fragment faces and text.
entries.native_impl: Loop strips; clip and offset each by staggered eased value.

entries.definition: Text rises into view from behind an invisible mask aligned to its baseline, appearing to emerge from a slot.
entries.prompt_phrase: Each word rises 110% of cap height from behind a baseline mask, 60 ms stagger, 520 ms outExpo, hold 1.2 s.
entries.pitfalls: Mask clipping descenders; extend mask 25% below baseline.
entries.native_impl: ctx.save(); clip rect to line box; draw at y + (1-e)*h.

entries.definition: Each glyph animates individually with a small offset, creating a ripple through the word.
entries.prompt_phrase: Letters fade 0→1 and rise 16 px with 25 ms stagger, 400 ms outCubic each, left to right.
entries.best_for: Short words, brand names, single-line titles
entries.pitfalls: Over 30 characters the cascade takes too long.
entries.native_impl: Measure each glyph with measureText; draw per char at cumulative x.

entries.definition: Words animate in one at a time, matching spoken cadence.
entries.prompt_phrase: Words fade and rise 24 px, 90 ms stagger, 450 ms outQuart, synced to voice-free beat at 120 BPM eighths.
entries.pitfalls: Splitting on spaces breaks joined punctuation; keep it attached.
entries.native_impl: Split by /\s+/; layout once; animate per word.

entries.definition: Each line of a multi-line block enters separately with an offset.
entries.prompt_phrase: Three lines rise 32 px from baseline masks, 120 ms stagger, 600 ms outExpo.
entries.pitfalls: Line breaks must be fixed per aspect ratio, not auto.
entries.native_impl: Pre-break lines per layout; clip per line box.

entries.definition: Letter spacing animates from tight to open (or reverse), giving text a breathing reveal.
entries.prompt_phrase: Title tracking animates from -2% to +12% of font size over 2.4 s outQuart while opacity goes 0→1 in first 600 ms.
entries.best_for: Elegant titles, end cards, all-caps lockups
entries.pitfalls: Re-centering every frame causes jitter; center on total width.
entries.native_impl: ctx.letterSpacing where supported, or manual per-glyph x offsets.

entries.definition: A variable font's weight axis animates continuously, making text thicken or thin.
entries.prompt_phrase: Headline weight animates from 200 to 800 on the wght axis over 700 ms inOutCubic, using an OFL variable font.
entries.best_for: Emphasis without moving text, sound-reactive type
entries.pitfalls: Width shifts with weight; reserve space or use fixed-width axis.
entries.native_impl: FontFace with variable OFL font; CSS font-variation-settings per frame.

entries.definition: Characters appear one by one at a steady rate, often with a blinking cursor.
entries.prompt_phrase: Type on at 28 characters per second, cursor 2 px wide blinking 530 ms on/off, hold 1.0 s after last char.
entries.pitfalls: Uneven per-character timing reads as stutter unless seeded.
entries.native_impl: visible = floor((t - t0)*cps); draw substring.

entries.definition: Characters cycle through random glyphs before locking into the final text left to right.
entries.prompt_phrase: Each character cycles seeded random glyphs every 2 frames for 300 ms, then locks; lock order left-to-right, 30 ms stagger.
entries.pitfalls: Proportional fonts jitter width; use tabular/mono for this.
entries.native_impl: Seeded PRNG per char index and frame; monospace OFL font.

entries.definition: A word arrives oversized and snaps to its final size with a hard stop, often with a beat hit.
entries.prompt_phrase: Word scales 2.6x→1.0x over 160 ms outExpo with 1-frame white flash at 18% and 4 px camera shake decaying over 200 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Repeated slams lose impact; limit to 2 per 30 s.
entries.native_impl: Scale about text center; shake via seeded offset.

entries.definition: Glyphs are positioned and rotated along a curve and can travel along it.
entries.prompt_phrase: Tagline flows along a cubic arc, offset animating 0→100% over 3 s inOutSine, glyphs rotate to tangent.
entries.pitfalls: Tight curves crowd glyphs; keep radius above 3x cap height.
entries.native_impl: Sample path arclength; per glyph translate+rotate to tangent.

entries.definition: A colored band sweeps behind a word as if drawn with a highlighter.
entries.prompt_phrase: Highlight band at 35% cap height behind 'faster' sweeps left-to-right in 380 ms outCubic, 2 px rounded ends.
entries.pitfalls: Band over the glyphs instead of behind kills contrast.
entries.native_impl: Draw rect width e*wordWidth before the text.

entries.definition: An underline draws itself under a word from one end to the other.
entries.prompt_phrase: Underline 3 px thick, 6 px below baseline, draws 0→100% in 300 ms outQuart starting 200 ms after word settles.
entries.pitfalls: Underline through descenders; break around them or drop lower.
entries.native_impl: SVG stroke-dashoffset or ctx.lineTo eased x.

entries.definition: Each digit scrolls vertically through intermediate numbers to its final value, like a mechanical counter.
entries.prompt_phrase: Each digit column rolls to its target over 900 ms outCubic, right column fastest, 40 ms stagger leftward, tabular figures.
entries.pitfalls: Proportional digits shift layout; use tabular figures.
entries.native_impl: Per column clip; draw digits stacked; translate y by eased value.

entries.definition: One word in a sentence cycles through alternatives while the rest stays fixed.
entries.prompt_phrase: Last word cycles 4 options every 900 ms: old word exits up 100% in 220 ms inCubic, new enters from below 320 ms outExpo.
entries.best_for: Use cases list in one line
entries.pitfalls: Width changes jerk the sentence; animate container width too.
entries.native_impl: Measure each word; tween slot width with outCubic.

entries.definition: Text resolves from blurred and slightly scaled to sharp, like a lens finding focus.
entries.prompt_phrase: Title blurs 12→0 px, scales 1.06→1.0 and fades 0→1 over 700 ms outCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Blurred text at full opacity looks like a render bug.
entries.native_impl: ctx.filter='blur()' on text layer; opacity leads blur by 100 ms.

entries.definition: Glyph outlines draw on first, then the interior fills.
entries.prompt_phrase: Glyph outlines draw over 900 ms linear at 1.5 px, then fill fades in over 300 ms outQuad.
entries.pitfalls: Needs glyph paths; use opentype parsing of an OFL font.
entries.native_impl: Parse OFL font with a bundled glyph parser to SVG paths; stroke-dashoffset.

entries.definition: Text is revealed by a mask opening from its horizontal center outward.
entries.prompt_phrase: Mask opens from center to full word width over 450 ms outExpo, text static behind it.
entries.pitfalls: Uneven word widths make the opening look off-center.
entries.native_impl: Clip rect x=cx-e*w/2, width=e*w.

entries.definition: Text color fills from one side like liquid, changing from outline or gray to brand color.
entries.prompt_phrase: Word fills from gray #8A8F98 to white left-to-right over 600 ms inOutSine, synced with progress bar.
entries.pitfalls: Fill edge without slight softness aliases.
entries.native_impl: Draw gray text, then clip rect e*w and draw colored text.

entries.definition: Adjusting spacing and design for size: display text needs tighter tracking and kerning than small text.
entries.prompt_phrase: Headlines over 96 px set at -2% tracking with font kerning on; captions under 28 px at +1%.
entries.pitfalls: Default tracking on huge type looks loose and amateur.
entries.native_impl: ctx.fontKerning='normal'; letterSpacing per size tier.

entries.definition: A fixed ratio between type sizes so headline, subhead and caption feel related.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use a 1.333 ratio: caption 24 px, body 32 px, subhead 43 px, headline 76 px, hero 135 px at 1080 px frame height.
entries.pitfalls: Too many sizes; max 3 per frame.
entries.native_impl: size_n = base * ratio^n; scale base by frame height/1080.

entries.definition: A fixed composed group of text elements whose spacing never changes during animation.
entries.prompt_phrase: Lockup: headline 76 px, 24 px gap, subhead 32 px at 70% opacity; the group animates as one unit, 500 ms outExpo.
entries.pitfalls: Animating lockup parts with independent ease breaks spacing.
entries.native_impl: Compute layout once; animate a parent transform.

entries.definition: Masks around animated text extended so ascenders, descenders and accents are never clipped.
entries.prompt_phrase: Extend all line masks 30% of font size above cap height and 30% below baseline.
entries.pitfalls: Tight masks cut off g, y, j and accents.
entries.native_impl: Use measureText actualBoundingBoxAscent/Descent plus padding.

entries.definition: Wide horizontal frame for keynote screens and desktop players; supports side-by-side text and visual.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render 1920x1080; text column occupies left 40% with 7% outer margin, hero visual centered at 65% x.
entries.best_for: Keynote stages, websites, desktop video players
entries.pitfalls: Center-only layouts waste the width.
entries.native_impl: canvas 1920x1080; layout from normalized coordinates.

entries.definition: Square frame that centers composition and favors stacked text above visual.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render 1080x1080; headline top 18-32% band, visual 40-85%, margins 8%.
entries.best_for: Feeds where square reads well, thumbnails
entries.pitfalls: Side-by-side layouts shrink type below legibility.
entries.native_impl: Same scene graph; layout preset 'square' chooses stacked arrangement.

entries.definition: Slightly tall frame that maximizes feed real estate while keeping comfortable stacking room.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render 1080x1350; headline in top 25%, visual centered at 55% y filling 70% width, CTA in bottom 12%.
entries.pitfalls: Treating it as 9:16 crops important edges.
entries.native_impl: Layout preset with vertical stack and 7% margins.

entries.definition: Full-phone vertical frame; content stacks vertically and must avoid platform UI overlays.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render 1080x1920; keep text between 14% and 72% height, horizontal margins 8%, nothing critical in bottom 20% or right 12%.
entries.pitfalls: Placing captions where platform buttons sit.
entries.native_impl: Layout preset 'vertical'; overlay a safe-zone guide in QA renders.

entries.definition: One scene described in normalized units that re-lays out per aspect rather than cropping one master.
entries.prompt_phrase: Define anchors in 0-1 space per aspect: 16:9 text-left/visual-right, 1:1 and 4:5 stacked, 9:16 stacked with type +12%.
entries.best_for: Delivering one film in 4 aspect ratios
entries.pitfalls: Cropping 16:9 to 9:16 cuts the subject and text.
entries.native_impl: layout(aspect) returns rects; draw functions read rects only.

entries.definition: Inner frame region where text and essential elements are guaranteed visible.
entries.prompt_phrase: Keep all text inside a 90% title-safe box (5% inset each side) and key visuals inside 95%.
entries.pitfalls: Text touching edges looks cropped on many players.
entries.native_impl: Constant SAFE = {x:0.05,y:0.05}; assert in layout QA.

entries.definition: Areas of vertical frames covered by app buttons, captions and usernames on social platforms.
entries.prompt_phrase: On 9:16, reserve bottom 20% and right 12% as no-text zones; top 10% only for non-critical decor.
entries.pitfalls: Logo or CTA hidden under on-screen buttons.
entries.native_impl: Draw translucent red guide in debug frames; strip in final.

entries.definition: Place key subjects on lines or intersections dividing the frame into a 3x3 grid.
entries.prompt_phrase: Product centered on the right-third vertical (x=66.7%), headline baseline on the lower-third line (y=66.7%).
entries.pitfalls: Applying to perfectly symmetric logo cards.
entries.native_impl: Anchor points at w/3, 2w/3, h/3, 2h/3.

entries.definition: Subject placed exactly at frame center with mirrored balance, conveying stability and confidence.
entries.prompt_phrase: Logo centered at 50%/48% (optical center slightly above), 30% frame width, equal empty space on all sides.
entries.best_for: End cards, logo reveals, product hero
entries.pitfalls: Dead-center vertically looks low; lift 2%.

entries.definition: Intentional empty area that isolates the subject and signals premium restraint.
entries.prompt_phrase: Keep at least 55% of the frame empty around the single headline; no decorative elements in that zone.
entries.pitfalls: Filling every gap with particles or icons.
entries.native_impl: Budget: measure covered area per frame in QA.

entries.definition: Invisible columns and gutters to which all elements align.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use a 12-column grid with 6% outer margins and 1.5% gutters at 16:9; 4 columns at 9:16.
entries.pitfalls: Elements slightly off-grid look accidental.
entries.native_impl: col(i) = margin + i*(colW + gutter).

entries.definition: Size, contrast, position and motion rank elements so the eye reads them in a planned order.
entries.prompt_phrase: Rank 3 levels: headline 1.0 size full white, subhead 0.42 size 70% opacity, caption 0.32 size 55%; only level 1 animates at full energy.
entries.best_for: Any frame with more than one element
entries.pitfalls: Two elements at equal weight compete.
entries.native_impl: Hierarchy table maps level to size/opacity/motion amplitude.

entries.definition: The single location the eye should land first in a frame.
entries.prompt_phrase: One focal point per shot: brightest value (L 95), highest contrast and first motion all at the product screen.
entries.pitfalls: Brightest area and moving area in different places.
entries.native_impl: Vignette and contrast centered on focal coordinates.

entries.definition: Lines in the composition that guide the eye toward the subject.
entries.prompt_phrase: Three perspective grid lines converge on the logo at frame center; lines fade from 25% to 0% opacity toward edges.
entries.best_for: Pointing to a product or headline
entries.pitfalls: Lines leading out of the frame pull attention away.
entries.native_impl: Draw lines from edges toward focal point.

entries.definition: Pairing very large and very small elements to create drama and hierarchy.
entries.prompt_phrase: Hero number at 46% frame height paired with a 2.2% label beside it.
entries.pitfalls: Medium-everything reads flat.
entries.native_impl: Size ratio between levels at least 4:1.

entries.definition: Arrange elements so the eye scans top-left, top-right, diagonally to bottom-left, then bottom-right.
entries.prompt_phrase: Logo at top-left (6%,6%), headline top-right, product center-left, CTA bottom-right at (88%,88%).
entries.pitfalls: RTL audiences read mirrored.
entries.native_impl: Assign anchors in Z order; animate in the same order.

entries.definition: Using an element such as a device screen or window to frame the subject inside the shot.
entries.prompt_phrase: Content plays inside a rounded device screen occupying 48% frame height, 1.5% bezel, rest of frame darkened to 20%.
entries.pitfalls: Inner content too small to read; scale UI 1.4x for video.
entries.native_impl: Clip content to inner rounded rect; draw bezel after.

entries.definition: Where the floor or horizon line sits, affecting perceived weight and grandeur.
entries.prompt_phrase: Place the floor horizon at 72% height for a grounded hero, or 30% for a sky-dominant opener.
entries.pitfalls: Horizon through the subject's middle splits it.
entries.native_impl: Camera pitch chosen so ground plane meets view at target y.

entries.definition: Elements placed so close to frame edges they feel cramped or cut; avoid unless intentional.
entries.prompt_phrase: Keep every element at least 5% from frame edges, or bleed it at least 15% off-frame; never 1-4%.
entries.pitfalls: Near-touching edges looks like a crop error.
entries.native_impl: QA: flag bounding boxes within 1-4% of edges.

entries.definition: Composing distinct foreground, midground and background planes to create depth.
entries.prompt_phrase: Three planes: blurred foreground shapes at 8 px blur, sharp product midground, background gradient at 60% luminance.
entries.pitfalls: Background as bright as subject collapses depth.
entries.native_impl: Draw order back to front; per-plane blur and parallax factor.

entries.definition: Aligning text baselines and element edges to common lines across the frame.
entries.prompt_phrase: Align the headline baseline and the stat's baseline to y=58% exactly; snap to a 8 px baseline grid.
entries.pitfalls: Aligning boxes instead of baselines makes text look offset.
entries.native_impl: Draw text with textBaseline='alphabetic' at grid y.

entries.definition: The point slightly above the geometric center where a centered element looks balanced.
entries.prompt_phrase: Center lockups at 47-48% frame height instead of 50%.
entries.pitfalls: Math-center placement looks like it is sinking.

entries.definition: The dominant light source that defines form and the direction of shadows.
entries.prompt_phrase: Key light from upper-left at 45° azimuth, 35° elevation, intensity 1.0, color temperature about 5600K (#FFF4E8).
entries.pitfalls: Key from directly front flattens form.
entries.native_impl: Directional light uniform; Lambert/GGX in fragment shader.

entries.definition: Secondary softer light opposite the key that lifts shadow detail.
entries.prompt_phrase: Fill from right at 30% of key intensity, slightly cool #E8F0FF, no specular contribution.
entries.pitfalls: Fill as strong as key removes shape.
entries.native_impl: Second diffuse-only light term.

entries.definition: Light from behind the subject that outlines its silhouette against the background.
entries.prompt_phrase: Rim light from behind-above at 150% key intensity, producing a 2-4 px bright edge on the product outline.
entries.best_for: Separating dark products from dark backgrounds
entries.pitfalls: Rim on all sides looks like a glow outline.
entries.native_impl: Fresnel-weighted term pow(1-dot(N,V),3) masked by light direction.

entries.definition: Classic setup of key, fill and rim lights giving shape, readable shadows and separation.
entries.prompt_phrase: Key 1.0 upper-left, fill 0.3 right, rim 1.5 behind-top; background 1.5 stops darker than subject.
entries.pitfalls: Equal intensities kill drama.
entries.native_impl: Three light uniforms summed in shader.

entries.definition: Large light source producing soft gradual shadows and broad smooth highlights.
entries.prompt_phrase: Simulate a softbox: rectangular highlight reflection 30% of product width, shadows with 40 px penumbra.
entries.pitfalls: Point lights on glossy surfaces give tiny harsh dots.
entries.native_impl: Analytic rectangle light or blurred env-map strip; PCF soft shadows.

entries.definition: Small light source producing sharp-edged shadows and contrasty highlights.
entries.prompt_phrase: Single hard light at 70° elevation, shadow edge under 2 px, background in 10% gray.
entries.pitfalls: Hard shadows reveal geometry seams.
entries.native_impl: Shadow map without filtering, or ray-marched SDF shadows with k=64.

entries.definition: Surfaces reflect more at grazing angles, brightening edges of glass, water and coatings.
entries.prompt_phrase: Reflectance rises from 4% facing to 100% at grazing via Schlick (F0=0.04, power 5).
entries.pitfalls: Too strong fresnel makes objects look like rim-lit plastic.

entries.definition: A bright highlight band moves across a surface, revealing gloss and form.
entries.prompt_phrase: Highlight band 18% surface width sweeps diagonally across the device in 1.2 s inOutSine, peak +40% brightness.
entries.pitfalls: Sweeping every element makes the film look like a template.
entries.native_impl: Animate a linear gradient in surface UV; additive, masked by object.

entries.definition: Lighting and reflections derived from an environment map generated in code rather than a photo.
entries.prompt_phrase: Generate a 256x128 equirect environment in code: dark gray base, two softbox rectangles at luminance 8 and 3, horizon gradient.
entries.best_for: Realistic reflections on metal and glass
entries.pitfalls: Using downloaded HDRI files violates the native-only rule.
entries.native_impl: Render env to float texture in shader; sample by reflect(V,N); prefilter mips.

entries.definition: Darkening where surfaces are close together and ambient light is blocked.
entries.prompt_phrase: Apply SDF ambient occlusion with 5 samples at 0.02-0.1 step, strength 0.6, darkening creases and floor contact.
entries.pitfalls: Over-strong AO looks dirty.
entries.native_impl: SDF AO loop; or screen-space AO from depth.

entries.definition: Small dark soft shadow where an object meets a surface, anchoring it.
entries.prompt_phrase: Ellipse contact shadow 90% object width, 0.35 opacity at center to 0 at edge, shrinks 30% as object lifts 40 px.
entries.best_for: Floating products, UI cards on surfaces
entries.pitfalls: Missing contact shadow makes objects hover.
entries.native_impl: Radial gradient ellipse drawn under object; scale by height.

entries.definition: Transparent material bending the background behind it, with fresnel edges and highlights.
entries.prompt_phrase: Glass panel refracts background with IOR 1.45, 6 px offset at edges, 4% tint, fresnel edge highlight 1.5 px.
entries.pitfalls: Refraction without edge highlight looks like a distortion bug.
entries.native_impl: Sample background texture at uv + normal.xy*strength; add fresnel.

entries.definition: Translucent material that blurs and lightens whatever is behind it.
entries.prompt_phrase: Panel blurs backdrop 24 px, adds white at 12%, 1 px inner border at 20% white, 20 px corner radius.
entries.pitfalls: Blur on low-contrast backgrounds becomes invisible gray.
entries.native_impl: Draw backdrop region to offscreen with ctx.filter blur; clip to panel.

entries.definition: Metal with fine directional grooves that stretch highlights along one axis.
entries.prompt_phrase: Aluminum base #C9CCD1, roughness 0.35 along x and 0.08 along y, plus 1-px seeded line noise at 6% contrast.
entries.pitfalls: Isotropic highlights read as plastic.
entries.native_impl: Anisotropic GGX with tangent; procedural streak noise.

entries.definition: Low-gloss material with broad soft highlight and strong diffuse color.
entries.prompt_phrase: Base color #2B2F36, roughness 0.7, specular F0 0.04, very soft highlight peak 15% above base.
entries.pitfalls: Pure Lambert with no specular looks like clay.
entries.native_impl: GGX with roughness 0.6-0.8.

entries.definition: Light scatters inside a material, softening shadows and adding warm translucency at thin edges.
entries.prompt_phrase: Wrap-lighting term 0.4 and thickness-based back-light tint #FF8A6A at 25% on thin edges.
entries.best_for: Wax, jelly, organic or soft forms
entries.pitfalls: Uniform glow loses all shading.
entries.native_impl: Wrap diffuse: (dot(N,L)+w)/(1+w); add thickness-attenuated backlight.

entries.definition: Surfaces that emit light themselves, staying bright regardless of scene lighting.
entries.prompt_phrase: Screen surface emits at luminance 1.6 (above 1.0 white) so it blooms subtly; bezel stays unlit.
entries.pitfalls: Emissive values above 4 clip into blobs.
entries.native_impl: Add emissive*color before tonemap in float buffer.

entries.definition: Bright areas bleed soft light into surrounding pixels, simulating lens and eye scatter.
entries.prompt_phrase: Bloom threshold 0.9, 5-level downsampled blur, intensity 0.25, warm tint 5%.
entries.pitfalls: High intensity makes the whole frame hazy.
entries.native_impl: Bright pass, mip chain blur, upsample-add in WebGL.

entries.definition: Visible beams of light through haze, emanating from a bright source past occluders.
entries.prompt_phrase: Light shafts from top-left source, 64 radial samples, decay 0.96, density 0.8, exposure 0.18.
entries.pitfalls: Too many samples bands; dither the start offset.
entries.native_impl: Radial blur of occlusion mask toward light screen position.

entries.definition: Surface color shifts with viewing angle, cycling through hues like a soap bubble.
entries.prompt_phrase: Hue shifts across 240° as viewing angle goes 0→70°, film thickness 380 nm simulated, mixed 30% over base.
entries.pitfalls: Full-strength rainbow everywhere looks cheap.
entries.native_impl: color = 0.5+0.5*cos(2PI*(thickness*cosTheta*k + vec3(0,.33,.67))).

entries.definition: Bright moving patterns of focused light cast through water or glass.
entries.prompt_phrase: Animated caustic pattern on the floor from 3 octaves of warped Voronoi, 0.4 speed, additive at 20%.
entries.best_for: Water, glass products, calm underwater scenes
entries.pitfalls: Too-high contrast looks like a texture overlay.
entries.native_impl: Procedural Voronoi edge distance, warped by noise, additive.

entries.definition: A thin glossy layer over a base material, adding a sharp reflection above a softer one.
entries.prompt_phrase: Base roughness 0.5 colored, plus clearcoat layer roughness 0.05 at F0 0.04 strength 0.8.
entries.pitfalls: Double highlights misaligned look broken.
entries.native_impl: Sum two GGX lobes with energy compensation.

entries.definition: A curved floor-to-wall backdrop with no visible horizon, for studio-style product shots.
entries.prompt_phrase: Seamless backdrop curving with 1.5-unit radius, base #EDEEF0, gradient to 85% at top, soft shadow under product.
entries.pitfalls: Visible seam or horizon line breaks the illusion.
entries.native_impl: SDF plane blended with smooth min into wall; or radial gradient in 2D.

entries.definition: Mapping high-dynamic-range light values into display range with a soft shoulder instead of hard clipping.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render in linear float, exposure 1.0, apply a filmic curve with shoulder starting at 0.8, then sRGB encode.
entries.best_for: Any WebGL scene with bright lights or bloom
entries.pitfalls: Tonemapping twice or skipping sRGB encode.
entries.native_impl: x*(a*x+b)/(x*(c*x+d)+e) rational fit in final pass.

entries.definition: Global brightness multiplier applied before tonemapping, measured in stops (each doubles light).
entries.prompt_phrase: Set exposure +0.5 stops (x1.41) for the opener, ramp to 0 stops over 2 s as the logo appears.
entries.pitfalls: Changing exposure after tonemap shifts contrast too.
entries.native_impl: color *= pow(2, ev) before tonemap.

entries.definition: Tone curve that darkens shadows and brightens highlights while keeping midtones, adding punch.
entries.prompt_phrase: Apply S-curve pivot at 0.45: shadows -6%, highlights +5%, midtones unchanged.
entries.pitfalls: Crushing UI text in shadows.
entries.native_impl: smoothstep-based curve mixed 0.3 with identity.

entries.definition: Independent color and level adjustments for shadows, midtones and highlights.
entries.prompt_phrase: Lift shadows toward blue +0.02, gamma neutral, gain highlights warm (+0.03 R, -0.02 B).
entries.best_for: Precise grading in a final pass
entries.pitfalls: Large lift values wash out blacks.
entries.native_impl: c = pow(gain*(c + lift*(1-c)), 1/gamma).

entries.definition: Shadows and highlights tinted with opposing hues, often cool shadows and warm highlights.
entries.prompt_phrase: Tint shadows below 0.3 luminance toward #1E3A5F at 12%, highlights above 0.7 toward #FFD9A8 at 8%.
entries.best_for: Cinematic mood without color cast on midtones
entries.pitfalls: Brand colors drift; exempt logo layer.
entries.native_impl: Luminance-weighted mix of two tint colors.

entries.definition: Entire frame is near-neutral with a single saturated accent drawing all attention.
entries.prompt_phrase: Desaturate everything to 8% chroma; only the CTA button keeps full brand color.
entries.pitfalls: Second accent splits attention.
entries.native_impl: Grade layer except accent-masked objects.

entries.definition: Using a small fixed set of colors for the whole film for coherence.
entries.prompt_phrase: Palette locked to 4 values: background #0E1116, surface #1C222B, text #F2F4F7, accent #5B8CFF; no other hues.
entries.pitfalls: Gradient interpolation sneaking in off-palette mid hues.
entries.native_impl: PALETTE constant; QA scans frames for out-of-palette hue clusters.

entries.definition: Overall warmth or coolness of light, measured in kelvin; drives mood.
entries.prompt_phrase: Grade the problem act cool (white point near 7500K, #E6EEFF) and the solution act warm (near 4500K, #FFF1E0), 1 s transition.
entries.pitfalls: Changing temperature mid-shot without motivation.
entries.native_impl: Multiply by white-point RGB; lerp across acts.

entries.definition: Keeping average saturation low so accents and brand colors stand out.
entries.prompt_phrase: Keep background chroma under 0.04 in OKLCH and only accents above 0.15.
entries.pitfalls: Oversaturated gradients read as generic machine-made output.
entries.native_impl: Convert to OKLCH, clamp C per layer.

entries.definition: Blending colors in a perceptually uniform space so gradients do not pass through muddy or gray midpoints.
entries.prompt_phrase: Interpolate the blue-to-orange gradient in OKLCH with 64 stops, hue taking the shorter arc.
entries.pitfalls: sRGB lerp between complements goes gray in the middle.
entries.native_impl: Convert sRGB to OKLab in JS; build gradient stops; or in shader.

entries.definition: A planned sequence of dominant colors across the film's beats.
entries.prompt_phrase: Color script for 30 s: 0-8 s desaturated navy, 8-18 s brightening teal, 18-26 s warm white, 26-30 s brand accent on black.
entries.pitfalls: Each scene picking colors independently.
entries.native_impl: Array of {t, palette}; grade lerps between keyframes.

entries.definition: Brand colors must render at their exact sRGB values in the final encode.
entries.prompt_phrase: Draw brand color #5B8CFF ungraded, encode with bt709 tags so sampled output stays within 2 delta-E.
entries.pitfalls: Grade, bloom or YUV range conversion shifting brand hues.
entries.native_impl: Render logo after grade pass; ffmpeg -colorspace bt709 -color_range tv tags.

entries.definition: Using a dark tinted gray instead of pure #000 to keep depth and avoid compression blocking.
entries.prompt_phrase: Background #0B0D10 (not #000000), gradient to #151922 at the focal area.
entries.pitfalls: Pure black blocks and bands after encoding.
entries.native_impl: Fill with near-black; add dither.

entries.definition: How brightest values approach white: smoothly rather than abruptly clipping.
entries.prompt_phrase: Highlights above 0.85 compress with a soft shoulder so nothing exceeds 0.98 except intentional flashes.
entries.pitfalls: Hard white clipping makes flat blotches.
entries.native_impl: Shoulder in tonemap or c = 1 - exp(-c*k).

entries.definition: Colors neighboring on the hue wheel, giving harmonious low-tension looks.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use hues 200°, 225° and 250° in OKLCH with lightness 0.25/0.55/0.85 for background, surface and highlight.
entries.pitfalls: No contrast hue means CTAs disappear.
entries.native_impl: Generate palette by stepping OKLCH hue.

entries.definition: An accent from the opposite side of the hue wheel to make one element pop.
entries.prompt_phrase: Blue-dominant scene (hue 240°) with a single orange accent at hue 60°, covering under 5% of frame.
entries.pitfalls: Equal amounts of both hues vibrate.
entries.native_impl: Accent hue = base hue + 180°.

entries.definition: Image luminance mapped to a gradient between two colors.
entries.prompt_phrase: Map luminance to a 2-stop gradient: shadows #10233D, highlights #7FD4C1, applied to procedural textures.
entries.pitfalls: Low-contrast sources give a flat mush.
entries.native_impl: mix(c0, c1, luminance(color)) in shader.

entries.definition: The lowest luminance in the frame; raising or crushing it changes mood and legibility.
entries.prompt_phrase: Set black point at 4% luminance so shadows hold detail; never crush below 2% under UI.
entries.pitfalls: Lifted blacks look washed; crushed blacks hide detail.
entries.native_impl: c = blackPt + c*(1-blackPt).

entries.definition: Smooth color field defined by several colored points blended in two dimensions.
entries.prompt_phrase: 4-point mesh gradient: corners #1B2A49, #2E5E8C, #0E1726, #4A3C7A, control points drifting 3% over 8 s.
entries.pitfalls: Too saturated or fast-moving looks generic.
entries.native_impl: Inverse-distance weighting in shader with smooth falloff; OKLab mix.

entries.definition: Planning the frame in grayscale values so it reads clearly before color is added.
entries.prompt_phrase: Frame reads in 3 values: background 15% luminance, surfaces 35%, subject and type 90%.
entries.pitfalls: Relying on hue difference alone for separation.
entries.native_impl: QA: render grayscale thumbnail and check value separation.

entries.definition: Ensuring computed colors stay within displayable sRGB to avoid harsh clipping.
entries.prompt_phrase: Reduce OKLCH chroma in 0.005 steps until all sRGB channels sit within 0-1, keeping lightness fixed; never clip channels independently.
entries.pitfalls: Independent channel clipping shifts hue.
entries.native_impl: Binary search on chroma until all sRGB channels in 0..1.

entries.definition: A single final full-frame shader pass applying all color corrections in a fixed order.
entries.prompt_phrase: Order: exposure, white balance, tonemap, S-curve 0.3, split tone, saturation 0.92, sRGB encode, dither.
entries.pitfalls: Grading individual layers inconsistently.
entries.native_impl: One fragment shader on the composited float buffer.

entries.definition: Fine random luminance noise over the frame that adds organic texture and hides banding.
entries.prompt_phrase: Add monochrome grain at 3.5% amplitude, 1.5 px grain size, new seed per frame from frame index, stronger in midtones.
entries.pitfalls: Above 6% it turns to mush after H.264 encoding.
entries.native_impl: Shader: hash(uv*res + frame) - 0.5, weighted by l*(1-l)*4.

entries.definition: Tiny structured noise added before quantization to break up 8-bit gradient banding.
entries.prompt_phrase: Add ±0.5/255 triangular dither to every pixel in the final pass before writing 8-bit output.
entries.pitfalls: Skipping it on smooth gradients causes visible bands.

entries.definition: Gradual darkening toward the frame edges that focuses attention inward.
entries.prompt_phrase: Radial vignette starting at 55% of half-diagonal, 18% darkening at corners, smooth quadratic falloff.
entries.pitfalls: Strong vignettes on 9:16 crush the top and bottom text.
entries.native_impl: c *= 1 - k*smoothstep(r0, 1.0, length(uv-0.5)*1.41).

entries.definition: Red and blue channels slightly offset toward edges, simulating lens dispersion.
entries.prompt_phrase: Offset R outward and B inward by 0.15% of frame width at corners, zero at center.
entries.pitfalls: Applying to small text makes it unreadable.
entries.native_impl: Sample tex at uv±dir*k*r^2 per channel.

entries.definition: Warm reddish glow around bright highlights, as from light scattering back through film.
entries.prompt_phrase: Highlights above 0.85 get a 12 px warm (#FF5A3A) blur added at 10% intensity.
entries.pitfalls: Too strong reads as chromatic bloom error.
entries.native_impl: Bright pass, blur, tint red-orange, add.

entries.definition: Horizontal line pattern simulating old display rasters.
entries.prompt_phrase: Scanlines every 3 px at 8% darkening, with 0.5% vertical roll at 0.2 Hz.
entries.pitfalls: Scanline period near video downscale ratio causes moiré.
entries.native_impl: c *= 1 - k*step(0.5, fract(y/3)).

entries.definition: Subtle paper-like fiber and tooth texture over flat graphics for a tactile print feel.
entries.prompt_phrase: Overlay 3-octave value noise at 4% multiply plus 1-px seeded fibers at 2%, static across frames.
entries.pitfalls: Animated paper texture looks like boiling.
entries.native_impl: Generate once to offscreen canvas; multiply blend each frame.

entries.definition: A smooth color gradient finished with visible fine grain for a tactile, non-digital feel.
entries.prompt_phrase: Two-color OKLCH gradient with 5% static monochrome grain at 1 px, grain re-seeded every 2 frames.
entries.pitfalls: Grain too coarse fights small text.
entries.native_impl: Gradient fill then grain shader pass.

entries.definition: Image rendered as a grid of dots whose size encodes tone.
entries.prompt_phrase: Halftone at 45° screen angle, 8 px cell, dot radius proportional to sqrt(darkness).
entries.pitfalls: Fine screens moiré after scaling; use cell over 6 px.
entries.native_impl: Rotate uv, fract cell, circle SDF threshold by tone.

entries.definition: Tiny frame-to-frame positional drift simulating film moving through a projector.
entries.prompt_phrase: Shift the whole frame by seeded noise of ±0.6 px x and ±0.4 px y per frame.
entries.pitfalls: Large weave shakes text and makes viewers queasy.
entries.native_impl: Translate final composite by hash(frame).

entries.definition: Small frame-to-frame brightness variation simulating analog exposure instability.
entries.prompt_phrase: Global brightness flickers ±1.5% with seeded per-frame noise, smoothed over 3 frames.
entries.pitfalls: Larger flicker reads as encoding fault.
entries.native_impl: exposure *= 1 + 0.015*smoothNoise(frame).

entries.definition: Gentle overall glow that softens contrast and blooms highlights like a diffusion filter.
entries.prompt_phrase: Blend a 20 px blurred copy of the frame at 15% screen mode; highlights get an extra 8%.
entries.pitfalls: Over 25% blend looks foggy.
entries.native_impl: Blur pass then screen blend: 1-(1-a)*(1-b*k).

entries.definition: Smoothing jagged pixel steps along shape edges.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render at 2x resolution (3840x2160) and downsample with a box filter, or use 1-px smoothstep SDF edges.
entries.pitfalls: Shimmering edges during motion.
entries.native_impl: SDF: alpha = clamp(0.5 - d/fwidth(d), 0, 1); or supersample.

entries.definition: Rounded corners with gradually increasing curvature instead of a circular arc join.
entries.prompt_phrase: Cards use superellipse corners exponent 4, radius 4% of card width.
entries.pitfalls: Circular radius on large cards looks dated.
entries.native_impl: Superellipse SDF |x|^n+|y|^n=1 or Bezier approximation.

entries.definition: Shadow cast inside an element's edge, suggesting a recessed surface.
entries.prompt_phrase: Inset shadow 0 2 px 6 px at 25% black on input fields.
entries.pitfalls: Heavy inset looks dated and muddy.
entries.native_impl: Clip to shape, draw outer ring with shadowBlur.

entries.definition: Several soft shadows of different size stacked to approximate realistic diffuse occlusion.
entries.prompt_phrase: Card shadow stack: 0 1 px 2 px at 8%, 0 6 px 16 px at 10%, 0 24 px 48 px at 12%.
entries.pitfalls: Single big shadow looks like a smudge.
entries.native_impl: Multiple shadowBlur draws or blurred offscreen alpha.

entries.definition: Very thin edge stroke that defines surfaces on dark backgrounds.
entries.prompt_phrase: 1 px inner border at 10% white on dark cards, aligned to pixel grid with 0.5 px offset.
entries.pitfalls: Sub-pixel misalignment makes it blurry and shimmer.
entries.native_impl: ctx.strokeRect(x+0.5, y+0.5, w-1, h-1).

entries.definition: Warm colored glows bleeding in from frame edges, simulating stray light on film.
entries.prompt_phrase: Warm orange-to-magenta glow enters from the right edge over 800 ms, peaks at 35% screen blend, drifts and exits in 1.2 s; seeded noise shape.
entries.pitfalls: Downloaded leak overlays are stock assets; generate them.
entries.native_impl: Seeded noise-warped radial gradients, screen blend.

entries.definition: Reducing tones to a few flat levels for a graphic, poster-like look.
entries.prompt_phrase: Posterize luminance to 5 levels with 1 px soft steps, then map to palette.
entries.pitfalls: Unintended posterization from 8-bit gradients.
entries.native_impl: floor(l*n)/n with smoothstep edges.

entries.definition: Color layers slightly offset as in imperfect multi-pass printing.
entries.prompt_phrase: Offset the accent ink layer by 2 px right, 1 px down, multiply blend, static.
entries.pitfalls: Offsets on body text hurt legibility.
entries.native_impl: Draw each color separation with small translate, multiply.

entries.definition: Choosing texture scale and amplitude that survives video compression instead of turning into blocks.
entries.prompt_phrase: Keep texture features 2 px or larger and amplitude 3-5%; test at 8 Mbps H.264 and compare against the master frame.
entries.best_for: Any grain, noise or fine pattern
entries.pitfalls: Fine 1 px noise devours bitrate and blocks.
entries.native_impl: Render test clip; diff PSNR of textured regions post-encode.

entries.definition: Bars rise from the baseline to their values, staggered so comparison is felt.
entries.prompt_phrase: 7 bars grow from the x-axis with 70 ms stagger, 600 ms outCubic each; value labels fade in 150 ms after each bar settles.
entries.pitfalls: Bars not starting from zero baseline mislead.
entries.native_impl: height_i = value_i * e(t - i*0.07).

entries.definition: A line chart's path draws progressively from left to right along its length.
entries.prompt_phrase: Line draws left-to-right over 1.6 s inOutSine, 3 px stroke, leading dot 8 px riding the tip.
entries.pitfalls: Drawing by x-progress, not arclength, makes speed uneven on steep sections.
entries.native_impl: SVG stroke-dashoffset by length; or Canvas path up to arclength fraction.

entries.definition: A number animates from a start value to its final value.
entries.prompt_phrase: Count from 0 to 2,400,000 over 1.4 s outExpo, tabular figures, thousands separators, final value holds 1.5 s.
entries.pitfalls: Linear count lingers on meaningless digits; ease out.
entries.native_impl: v = round(target*e(t)); Intl.NumberFormat for separators.

entries.definition: Arc segments sweep clockwise from 12 o'clock to their proportions.
entries.prompt_phrase: Donut 28% stroke width sweeps from -90° clockwise over 900 ms outCubic; segments start sequentially, 2° gaps.
entries.pitfalls: More than 5 segments become unreadable.
entries.native_impl: ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,-PI/2, -PI/2 + 2PI*frac*e).

entries.definition: Axes and tick marks draw in before data, setting up the frame of reference.
entries.prompt_phrase: X axis draws left-to-right in 400 ms outQuart, ticks pop with 30 ms stagger, data begins at 500 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Building axes slower than data bores viewers.
entries.native_impl: Line with eased length; ticks with staggered opacity.

entries.definition: Faint gridlines appear quietly behind data to support reading values.
entries.prompt_phrase: Gridlines at 8% opacity fade in over 300 ms with 40 ms stagger bottom-up, 1 px.
entries.pitfalls: Gridlines as bright as data compete.
