entries.native_impl: Low-alpha lines drawn first.

entries.definition: Data markers scale in at their positions, usually after the line passes them.
entries.prompt_phrase: Each marker scales 0→1 in 240 ms outBack (1.5) the moment the drawing line reaches its x.
entries.pitfalls: All markers popping at once loses the reveal.
entries.native_impl: Trigger when drawn length passes marker's arclength.

entries.definition: One chart type continuously transforms into another, preserving data identity.
entries.prompt_phrase: Bars morph into a donut over 900 ms inOutCubic: each bar's height maps to its arc angle, colors constant.
entries.best_for: Showing the same data from two angles
entries.pitfalls: Changing data and form simultaneously confuses.
entries.native_impl: Interpolate per-datum geometry params; shared color keys.

entries.definition: One data series stays bright while all others dim, isolating the story.
entries.prompt_phrase: All lines dim to 20% opacity over 300 ms; the highlighted series thickens 2→4 px and turns accent color.
entries.pitfalls: Dimming below 10% hides context.
entries.native_impl: Per-series alpha track.

entries.definition: A label connected by a short line to a specific data point, explaining it.
entries.prompt_phrase: Leader line draws 40 px in 200 ms from the peak point, then label fades and slides 8 px over 250 ms outCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Callouts overlapping data or each other.
entries.native_impl: Line + text placed with collision check.

entries.definition: Layers of a stacked area chart grow upward from the baseline one series at a time.
entries.prompt_phrase: Each layer wipes in left-to-right over 800 ms inOutSine, layers start 200 ms apart, bottom first.
entries.pitfalls: Too many layers make muddy color bands.
entries.native_impl: Clip each area path by eased x rect.

entries.definition: Scatter points travel from a cluster into their plotted positions.
entries.prompt_phrase: 200 points fly from center to their positions over 900 ms outExpo, seeded per-point delay 0-300 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Random unseeded delays break determinism.
entries.native_impl: pos_i = lerp(origin, target_i, e(t - d_i)); d_i from seeded PRNG.

entries.definition: A path draws across a stylized map, with a moving head marking progress.
entries.prompt_phrase: Route draws along a vector map over 2.5 s inOutSine with a 10 px glowing head and fading 20% trail.
entries.pitfalls: Map tiles are external data; draw shapes from vector paths you author.
entries.native_impl: SVG/Canvas path with dashoffset; head at path.getPointAtLength.

entries.definition: Horizontal bars resort by value over time, with smooth position swaps.
entries.prompt_phrase: 12 bars update every 500 ms; value tweens 450 ms linear, rank swaps tween y over 300 ms inOutCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Too many bars and labels at 9:16.
entries.native_impl: Sort each step; tween y by rank index.

entries.definition: Circular stroke filling to represent percentage or completion.
entries.prompt_phrase: Ring 10 px stroke, round cap, fills 0→72% over 1.1 s outCubic, percentage counts up in the center.
entries.pitfalls: Round caps at 100% overlap visibly.
entries.native_impl: Arc with lineCap='round'; text count synced to e(t).

entries.definition: A tiny wordless line showing trend shape inline with text or a number.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sparkline 120x32 px, 2 px stroke, draws in 500 ms after the number lands, last point dot 4 px.
entries.pitfalls: Axes and labels on sparklines defeat the purpose.
entries.native_impl: Normalized path in small box.

entries.definition: Two states shown in sequence or side by side so change is obvious.
entries.prompt_phrase: Before bar at 40% height in gray, after bar grows to 85% in accent over 700 ms outExpo; delta label '+112%' pops at 750 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Different scales for before and after mislead.
entries.native_impl: Shared axis; animate the after state only.

entries.definition: Quantities shown as counts of identical small units in a grid.
entries.prompt_phrase: 10x10 dot grid, 37 dots fill accent color one by one at 15 ms stagger in reading order.
entries.pitfalls: Unit counts that do not equal the stated number.
entries.native_impl: Index i < count ? accent : neutral.

entries.definition: Axis range animates to a new scale while data repositions accordingly.
entries.prompt_phrase: Y axis domain animates from 0-100 to 0-1000 over 800 ms inOutCubic; tick labels crossfade, bars shrink proportionally.
entries.pitfalls: Ticks jumping instead of tweening confuse.
entries.native_impl: Interpolate domain; recompute positions each frame.

entries.definition: A small label with arrow showing increase or decrease, attached to a figure.
entries.prompt_phrase: Delta badge '▲ 38%' slides 12 px up and fades in over 250 ms outCubic, 300 ms after the counter lands; green #3DDC97.
entries.pitfalls: Red/green only fails for color-blind viewers; add arrow.
entries.native_impl: Rounded rect + glyph; color by sign.

entries.definition: Sequential bars show how increments and decrements move a start value to an end value.
entries.prompt_phrase: Each step bar drops from the previous running total over 400 ms outCubic, 150 ms stagger, connectors draw 120 ms after.
entries.pitfalls: Missing connectors make steps float.
entries.native_impl: Running total array; animate each bar from prev total.

entries.definition: Animate data so no intermediate frame shows false values that could be mistaken for truth.
entries.prompt_phrase: Hold final values at least 1.5 s; overshoot easings forbidden on data bars and numbers; use outCubic only.
entries.best_for: Any chart in a launch film
entries.pitfalls: outBack bars briefly show inflated values.
entries.native_impl: Lint: disallow back/elastic easing on data tracks.

entries.definition: A code-drawn pointer moving along eased curves to demonstrate interactions.
entries.prompt_phrase: Cursor travels along a gentle arc between targets in 600-800 ms inOutCubic, pauses 250 ms before each click, never moves linearly.
entries.pitfalls: Straight-line constant-speed cursors look robotic.
entries.native_impl: Draw arrow path at Bezier-eased position; timeline of targets.

entries.definition: Visual response to a press: brief scale-down and color shift, then release.
entries.prompt_phrase: On click, button scales to 0.96 in 80 ms outQuad, darkens 8%, releases to 1.0 with spring stiffness 400, damping 25.
entries.pitfalls: Press without release spring feels stuck.
entries.native_impl: Scale track keyed to click cue.

entries.definition: A translucent circle showing where a simulated finger touches a phone UI.
entries.prompt_phrase: Tap dot 44 px diameter, white at 35% with 2 px ring, scales 0.6→1.0 in 120 ms, fades out over 250 ms after release.
entries.pitfalls: Dot smaller than a fingertip reads as cursor.
entries.native_impl: Circle with ring, keyed to tap cues.

entries.definition: A circle expands and fades from the press point, confirming the interaction.
entries.prompt_phrase: Ring expands from tap point 0→120 px radius in 450 ms outCubic while opacity 0.4→0.
entries.pitfalls: Ripples on every frame element cause noise.
entries.native_impl: Arc stroke radius by e(t).

entries.definition: Element rises slightly with a larger shadow when the cursor approaches.
entries.prompt_phrase: Card translates -4 px and shadow blur grows 12→24 px over 180 ms outCubic when cursor enters.
entries.pitfalls: Lift too large reads as a jump.
entries.native_impl: Hover state track triggered by cursor bbox test.

entries.definition: A dialog appears above content with a dimmed backdrop.
entries.prompt_phrase: Backdrop fades to 50% black over 200 ms; dialog scales 0.94→1.0 and fades in over 260 ms outCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Dialog and backdrop timing identical feels flat.
entries.native_impl: Two tracks: backdrop alpha, dialog scale/alpha.

entries.definition: Panel slides up from the bottom edge to partial height.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sheet rises from 100% to 45% screen height with spring stiffness 300, damping 30; handle bar 36x5 px.
entries.pitfalls: Linear slides feel non-native.
entries.native_impl: Spring on y; content below clipped by device mask.

entries.definition: Small message slides in from the top, stays briefly, then leaves.
entries.prompt_phrase: Toast drops 64 px from top in 350 ms outBack(1.2), holds 1.8 s, exits up in 220 ms inCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Holding too briefly to read.
entries.native_impl: Translate y track with three keys.

entries.definition: An element in one screen grows and moves to become its counterpart in the next screen.
entries.prompt_phrase: Thumbnail expands to full-screen detail over 500 ms inOutCubic, corner radius 16→0 px, other items fade to 0 in first 150 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Content inside stretching instead of crossfading.
entries.native_impl: Interpolate rect and radius; crossfade inner content.

entries.definition: A new item enters a list while existing items move to make room.
entries.prompt_phrase: Existing rows shift down 72 px over 300 ms outCubic; new row fades and slides from -12 px starting at 120 ms.
entries.pitfalls: New item appearing before space opens causes overlap.
entries.native_impl: Layout target rects; tween y per row.

entries.definition: Gray placeholder shapes with a moving light band suggesting loading content.
entries.prompt_phrase: Placeholders #1E232B with a 30%-wide band at +6% brightness sweeping every 1.2 s linear, swap to content with 200 ms crossfade.
entries.pitfalls: Shimmer that never resolves into content.
entries.native_impl: Gradient translated by fract(t/1.2).

entries.definition: A knob slides across a track that changes color.
entries.prompt_phrase: Knob travels 20 px with spring stiffness 500, damping 30; track color crossfades gray to accent over 150 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Color change finishing after knob lands looks laggy.
entries.native_impl: Spring on knob x; color by knob progress.

entries.definition: Content scrolls as if flicked or dragged, with realistic momentum.
entries.prompt_phrase: Scroll 1200 px: accelerate 120 ms, cruise, decelerate over 700 ms with exponential decay time-constant 325 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Constant-speed scroll looks like a screen recording glitch.
entries.native_impl: y(t) from decay function; clip to viewport.

entries.definition: Characters appear in a text field as if typed, with caret and natural timing.
entries.prompt_phrase: Type at 14 chars/s with seeded ±30% jitter per key, caret blinks 530 ms when idle, field focus ring appears 150 ms before typing.
entries.pitfalls: Perfectly even timing reads mechanical.
entries.native_impl: Seeded per-key intervals; substring by elapsed.

entries.definition: Highlight outline indicating which control is active.
entries.prompt_phrase: Focus ring 2 px accent with 3 px offset, grows from 0 to full in 150 ms outCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Ring clipped by container edges.
entries.native_impl: Stroke rounded rect expanded by offset.

entries.definition: Active indicator glides between tabs, stretching slightly while moving.
entries.prompt_phrase: Indicator moves to the new tab over 320 ms inOutCubic, width lerps between tab widths, leading edge 40 ms ahead.
entries.pitfalls: Indicator teleporting between tabs.
entries.native_impl: Separate easing for left and right edges.

entries.definition: An item lifts, follows the pointer, and settles into a new slot as others reflow.
entries.prompt_phrase: Item lifts scale 1.04 and shadow +16 px in 120 ms, follows path over 700 ms, drops with spring stiffness 260, damping 22.
entries.pitfalls: Item and pointer drifting apart.
entries.native_impl: Item position = cursor + grabOffset; others tween to new slots.

entries.definition: A small capsule morphs smoothly into a larger card containing live content.
entries.prompt_phrase: Capsule 120x36 px expands to 360x120 px with spring stiffness 280, damping 24, content fades in after 60% of expansion.
entries.pitfalls: Content visible before container is large enough.
entries.native_impl: Rounded-rect size spring; content alpha gated by progress.

entries.definition: A menu opens and its items appear in a short stagger from the anchor.
entries.prompt_phrase: Menu scales from 0.9 at the anchor corner in 200 ms outCubic; 6 items fade in with 25 ms stagger.
entries.pitfalls: Stagger too long makes menus feel slow.
entries.native_impl: transform-origin at anchor; per-item delay.

entries.definition: A check mark draws itself inside a circle to confirm completion.
entries.prompt_phrase: Circle fills accent in 200 ms outCubic, then 4 px check stroke draws over 280 ms outQuart, scale bump 1.06 at end.
entries.pitfalls: Check drawing before circle finishes.
entries.native_impl: Two path segments with dashoffset.

entries.definition: UI content rendered inside a code-drawn device outline rather than a supplied product photo.
entries.prompt_phrase: Draw a generic device: rounded rect radius 11% width, 2% bezel #111, screen content clipped, 3D tilt 8° on Y.
entries.pitfalls: Using real branded device photos; draw a generic frame.
entries.native_impl: Rounded-rect path + clip; WebGL plane for tilt.

entries.definition: A region of UI is enlarged in a circle or card to show small details.
entries.prompt_phrase: Circular loupe 30% frame height shows the 2.5x enlarged button region, grows from 0 in 350 ms outBack(1.3).
entries.best_for: Showing small UI details legibly on phones
entries.pitfalls: Upscaling a low-resolution capture blurs; re-render at scale.
entries.native_impl: Clip circle; redraw UI with scale about target point.

entries.definition: A message bubble grows from its tail corner and settles, with typing dots preceding it.
entries.prompt_phrase: Typing dots bounce 3x at 400 ms period, then bubble scales 0.8→1.0 from the tail corner in 260 ms outBack(1.4).
entries.pitfalls: Bubbles all arriving at once.
entries.native_impl: Origin at tail; per-message cue times.

entries.definition: Flat layers at assigned depths move at different speeds to fake 3D space.
entries.prompt_phrase: Five layers at depths 1, 1.5, 2.5, 4, 8; camera drift of 60 px moves each layer by 60/depth px over 5 s inOutSine.
entries.pitfalls: Layer edges exposed when movement exceeds overscan; overscan 10%.
entries.native_impl: Canvas translate per layer by camOffset/depth.

entries.definition: Multiple cards arranged in depth, offset and rotated, suggesting a collection.
entries.prompt_phrase: 5 cards stacked with 24 px z-offset, each rotated 4° further, fanning out over 700 ms with 50 ms stagger outExpo.
entries.pitfalls: Uniform spacing looks mechanical; vary 10%.
entries.native_impl: CSS 3D transforms with perspective 1400 px; or WebGL quads.

entries.definition: A flat element rotated in 3D with perspective, giving depth to UI.
entries.prompt_phrase: Screen tilts to rotateX 12°, rotateY -18° with perspective 1600 px over 900 ms inOutCubic.
entries.pitfalls: Tilts beyond 30° make UI text unreadable.
entries.native_impl: CSS perspective + rotate3d; or projected quad in WebGL.

entries.definition: Parallel projection with equal axis angles so objects keep size regardless of depth.
entries.prompt_phrase: Isometric grid at 30° axes, 64 px tile, blocks extrude upward 0→target height over 500 ms outBack(1.2) staggered 40 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Mixing perspective elements breaks the look.
entries.native_impl: Map (x,y,z) to (x-y)*cos30, (x+y)*sin30 - z.

entries.definition: A flat shape given thickness along depth, turning a 2D mark into a solid.
entries.prompt_phrase: Logo outline extruded 6% of its width, bevel 0.8%, side faces 25% darker, rotates 25° on Y over 3 s.
entries.pitfalls: Vertex-heavy text extrusion; prefer SDF extrusion.
entries.native_impl: SDF: max(sdf2D(p.xy), abs(p.z)-h) raymarched.

entries.definition: Rendering 3D shapes defined by distance functions by stepping rays through a fragment shader.
entries.prompt_phrase: Raymarch with max 96 steps, epsilon 0.001, max distance 30; scene from smooth-union of 3 primitives with k=0.25.
entries.best_for: Organic shapes, morphing forms, logo sculptures
entries.pitfalls: Too many steps at 4K tanks render time; cap and early-exit.
entries.native_impl: Fragment shader loop: t += map(ro+rd*t).

entries.definition: Distant objects shift toward background color and lose contrast, conveying depth.
entries.prompt_phrase: Exponential fog density 0.08 toward #1A2230; objects at distance 20 retain 20% of their contrast.
entries.pitfalls: Fog color mismatched with background reveals edges.
entries.native_impl: color = mix(color, fogColor, 1 - exp(-d*density)).

entries.definition: Drawing elements back to front so nearer ones correctly occlude farther ones.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sort all 2.5D items by z each frame, stable sort with id tiebreaker, draw far to near.
entries.pitfalls: Unstable sort flickers when z values tie.
entries.native_impl: items.sort((a,b)=>b.z-a.z || a.id-b.id).

entries.definition: An object's components separate along axes to reveal internal structure.
entries.prompt_phrase: 6 layers separate along Z by 1.2 units each over 1.4 s inOutCubic with 80 ms stagger, labels draw on after 1.6 s.
entries.pitfalls: Parts flying in different directions randomly reads chaotic.
entries.native_impl: Offset each part by index*spacing*e(t).

entries.definition: Object rotates on a vertical axis in place, presenting all sides.
entries.prompt_phrase: Product rotates 360° on Y over 8 s linear for a seamless loop, camera elevation 15°.
entries.pitfalls: Fast spins strobe; under 60°/s at 30 fps.
entries.native_impl: Model matrix rotateY(2PI*t/8).

entries.definition: Flat sprites always rotated to face the camera, used for particles and labels in 3D.
entries.prompt_phrase: Labels render as camera-facing quads at fixed 28 px screen size regardless of depth.
entries.pitfalls: Scaling with depth makes far labels illegible.
entries.native_impl: Vertex shader: offset in view space; or project point and draw in 2D.

entries.definition: Per-pixel surface normals perturbed to fake fine geometric detail under lighting.
entries.prompt_phrase: Procedural normal map from 4-octave noise at strength 0.3 on the metal surface, 0.2 mm scale feel.
entries.pitfalls: Detail visible at silhouettes reveals flatness.
entries.native_impl: Compute normal from noise gradient via finite differences.

entries.definition: Drawing thousands of identical meshes in one call with per-instance attributes.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render 20,000 cubes with one instanced draw call, per-instance offset and seeded scale 0.5-1.5.
entries.best_for: Grids of objects, crowds, particle meshes
entries.pitfalls: Updating instance buffers on CPU every frame is slow.
entries.native_impl: gl.drawArraysInstanced with vertexAttribDivisor.

entries.definition: Gentle continuous bobbing and rotation keeping a hero object alive during holds.
entries.prompt_phrase: Product bobs ±6 px at 0.25 Hz sine and rotates ±2° at 0.17 Hz, phase-offset so the motion never repeats visibly in 10 s.
entries.best_for: Hero holds, end cards with product
entries.pitfalls: Bob amplitude large enough to distract from text.
entries.native_impl: y = A*sin(2PI*f1*t), rot = B*sin(2PI*f2*t + phi).

entries.definition: Ground plane showing a faded, blurred reflection of the object.
entries.prompt_phrase: Reflection at 25% opacity, fading to 0 over 30% of object height, blurred 4 px, floor color #0D0F12.
entries.pitfalls: Full-strength sharp reflections look dated.
entries.native_impl: Draw object flipped on Y with gradient mask and blur.

entries.definition: Combining size, blur, brightness and parallax to communicate distance in 2D.
entries.prompt_phrase: Far particles: 0.4x size, 4 px blur, 40% brightness, 0.3x parallax; near: 1.4x size, 6 px blur, full brightness, 1.6x parallax.
entries.pitfalls: Inconsistent cues contradict each other.
entries.native_impl: All parameters derived from one depth value.

entries.definition: Computing shadows by rendering depth from the light's point of view.
entries.prompt_phrase: 2048x2048 shadow map, 5x5 PCF filter, bias 0.0015, soft radius 2 texels.
entries.pitfalls: Shadow acne or peter-panning from wrong bias.
entries.native_impl: Depth pass from light, compare in main pass.

entries.definition: Projection with no perspective shrinking; sizes stay constant with distance.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use orthographic projection with view height 10 units for the diagram scene; rotate camera 35°/45° for isometric feel.
entries.pitfalls: Looks flat for hero product shots.
entries.native_impl: Ortho matrix: left/right/top/bottom from aspect.

entries.definition: Element tilts toward a simulated pointer position, reinforcing depth.
entries.prompt_phrase: Card tilts up to 8° toward the scripted cursor with spring stiffness 150, damping 20, highlight spot follows.
entries.best_for: Card showcases, interactive feel in demos
entries.pitfalls: Tilt reacting to non-existent pointer jitter.
entries.native_impl: rotX/rotY from cursor offset into spring.

entries.definition: Shapes merge with a smooth fillet where they meet, producing organic blobs.
entries.prompt_phrase: Three spheres merge with polynomial smooth-min k=0.35, orbiting at 0.2 Hz with radius 1.2.
entries.pitfalls: Large k turns everything into one blob.
entries.native_impl: smin(a,b,k) = min(a,b) - h*h*k/4, h=max(k-abs(a-b),0)/k.

entries.definition: A plane displaced by a height function to form landscape or abstract surface.
entries.prompt_phrase: 256x256 grid displaced by 5-octave fbm, amplitude 1.5 units, scrolling 0.05 units/s, wireframe at 15% opacity.
entries.pitfalls: Too high grid resolution with wireframe moirés.
entries.native_impl: Vertex shader samples noise for y.

entries.definition: Light scattering through a 3D density field rendered by stepping through volume.
entries.prompt_phrase: March 48 steps through a noise density field, scattering 0.6, absorption 0.2, light step 6 samples.
entries.pitfalls: Unjittered steps cause banding; add blue-noise offset.
entries.native_impl: Ray march accumulating transmittance with Beer-Lambert.

entries.definition: Particles advected by the curl of a noise field, producing swirling, non-clumping motion like smoke.
entries.prompt_phrase: Advect 40,000 particles through 3D curl noise at scale 0.8, speed 0.12 units/s, time offset 0.05/s, trails 0.92 decay.
entries.pitfalls: Gradient noise without curl makes particles clump.
entries.native_impl: curl = (dN3/dy - dN2/dz, ...) via finite differences in shader.

entries.definition: Many short strokes following a 2D vector field, revealing its structure like wind lines.
entries.prompt_phrase: Draw 3,000 seeded streamlines of 40 steps each through an angle field (noise * 2PI), 1 px at 30% opacity.
entries.pitfalls: Unseeded starts change each render.
entries.native_impl: Canvas2D path stepping pos += (cos a, sin a)*step.

entries.definition: Many particles emitted at once from a point with randomized velocities that decelerate and fade.
entries.prompt_phrase: Emit 400 particles from the logo center, speed 300-900 px/s seeded, drag 3.0/s, life 0.9-1.4 s, fade outQuad.
entries.pitfalls: Uniform speed gives a perfect ring that looks fake.
entries.native_impl: Analytic: p = p0 + v*(1-exp(-k t))/k; no stateful sim needed.

entries.definition: Scattered particles travel to points sampled on a target shape, assembling it.
entries.prompt_phrase: 6,000 particles sampled from logo pixels converge from a seeded cloud over 1.8 s outExpo with per-particle 0-400 ms delay.
entries.pitfalls: All arriving simultaneously looks like a tween; vary delays.
entries.native_impl: Sample target via offscreen canvas getImageData; lerp per particle.

entries.definition: Sparse, slow, softly lit specks drifting in the air, adding depth and atmosphere.
entries.prompt_phrase: 120 motes, 1-3 px, 10-40% opacity, drifting 4-12 px/s with 0.1 Hz noise, brightest in the light beam.
entries.pitfalls: Too many or too bright reads as snow.
entries.native_impl: Seeded positions; deterministic noise offsets by time.

entries.definition: Small bright particles with streaked motion, gravity and fast fade.
entries.prompt_phrase: Emit 80 sparks per hit, initial speed 600 px/s, gravity 900 px/s², streak length = velocity × 1/60 s, life 600 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Round sparks without streaks look like dots.
entries.native_impl: Draw line from pos to pos - v*dt; additive blending.

entries.definition: Flat colored pieces tumbling with flutter, gravity and air drag.
entries.prompt_phrase: 300 confetti rects 6x10 px in palette colors, gravity 500 px/s², drag 1.6, flutter rotation 3-8 rad/s, 2.5 s life.
entries.pitfalls: Off-brand rainbow colors; use palette only.
entries.native_impl: Analytic ballistic motion with seeded rotation; scaleY by cos(spin).

entries.definition: Agents following separation, alignment and cohesion rules, moving like a flock.
entries.prompt_phrase: 300 agents with separation radius 20 px, alignment 50 px, cohesion 80 px, max speed 140 px/s, fixed dt 1/120 s.
entries.pitfalls: Variable dt makes runs non-repeatable.
entries.native_impl: Fixed-step simulation from seed, prerolled before frame 0.

entries.definition: Points that pull or push particles, shaping motion around key elements.
entries.prompt_phrase: Logo acts as repulsor radius 180 px, strength 400; particles bend around it with falloff 1/r².
entries.best_for: Making particles respect text and products
entries.pitfalls: Singularities at r=0; add softening epsilon.
entries.native_impl: a = k*dir/(r²+eps²).

entries.definition: Each frame draws over a faded previous frame, leaving fading trails behind moving elements.
entries.prompt_phrase: Fade the previous frame by multiplying 0.9 each frame, then draw particles; trails ~10 frames long.
entries.pitfalls: Fade to non-zero floor leaves ghosting; clamp to background.
entries.native_impl: Ping-pong framebuffers; draw quad with alpha 0.1 background color.

entries.definition: Particle positions stored in float textures and updated by shaders, enabling hundreds of thousands of particles.
entries.prompt_phrase: Simulate 262,144 particles (512x512 float texture), update positions in a fragment shader each frame, render as 1.5 px points.
entries.pitfalls: Readback to CPU each frame kills speed.
entries.native_impl: WebGL2 RGBA32F textures + EXT_color_buffer_float ping-pong.

entries.definition: Particle set transitions between sampled shapes, preserving count.
entries.prompt_phrase: 20,000 points morph from sphere to logo over 1.5 s inOutCubic, sorted by angle so paths do not cross.
entries.pitfalls: Random pairings cause chaotic crossing paths.
entries.native_impl: Sort both point sets by same key; lerp.

entries.definition: Space divided into cells around seed points, giving organic, crystalline or biological patterns.
entries.prompt_phrase: Voronoi with 48 seeded points drifting 6 px/s, cell edges 1.5 px at 25% white, cells shaded by distance.
entries.pitfalls: Hard cell edges alias; use smooth edge distance.
entries.native_impl: Shader: loop 3x3 neighbor cells, min distance and second-min.

entries.definition: Simulated two-chemical system producing organic spots, stripes and maze patterns.
entries.prompt_phrase: Gray-Scott with feed 0.037, kill 0.06, 20 iterations per frame on 512x512, seeded with logo mask.
entries.pitfalls: Too few iterations per frame looks static.
entries.native_impl: Ping-pong fragment shader with Laplacian kernel.

entries.definition: Stars stream outward from a center, stretching into lines as speed increases.
entries.prompt_phrase: 2,000 stars, speed ramps 0.2→6 units/s over 1.2 s inExpo, streak length proportional to speed, fade near center.
entries.pitfalls: Overused; keep under 2 s.
entries.native_impl: Project 3D points, draw line from previous projection.

entries.definition: Particles falling slowly with sideways drift and depth variation.
entries.prompt_phrase: 600 flakes, 3 depth layers, fall 30-90 px/s, sway ±12 px at 0.3 Hz, size and blur by depth.
entries.pitfalls: Identical sway phase looks synchronized.
entries.native_impl: Seeded phase per flake; analytic position.

entries.definition: Particles or small objects circling a center on tilted elliptical paths.
entries.prompt_phrase: 3 rings tilted 15°, 30°, 60°, 80 particles each, periods 6, 9 and 14 s, back half dimmed 50%.
entries.pitfalls: No depth dimming makes front and back confusing.
entries.native_impl: Parametric ellipse + rotation; z from sin for dimming.

entries.definition: All randomness derived from a seeded generator so every render of a frame is identical.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use one 32-bit seeded PRNG (seed 1337) per system; per-particle values from hash(id, seed); never Math.random.
entries.pitfalls: Math.random causes frame differences between runs.
entries.native_impl: mulberry32(seed) or integer hash; hash(id*7919+frame).

entries.definition: Random points spaced with a minimum distance, giving even but natural scatter.
entries.prompt_phrase: Scatter 180 icons using Poisson disk sampling with minimum spacing 70 px, 30 attempts, seed 42.
entries.best_for: Icon clouds, star fields, dot backgrounds
entries.pitfalls: Pure random placement clusters and overlaps.
entries.native_impl: Dart throwing with an active list and background grid, seeded PRNG.

entries.definition: Moving points connected by lines whose opacity falls off with distance.
entries.prompt_phrase: 90 nodes drifting 8 px/s; connect pairs under 140 px with 1 px lines at opacity (1 - d/140)*0.4.
entries.pitfalls: Overused default look; restrain count and opacity.
entries.native_impl: Spatial hash grid for neighbor search.

entries.definition: Grid-based velocity and dye simulation producing realistic swirling liquid or smoke.
entries.prompt_phrase: Stable-fluids sim at 256x256, 20 pressure iterations, dye dissipation 0.98, vorticity 25, deterministic forcing from cue times.
entries.pitfalls: Interactive splats from random input break determinism.
entries.native_impl: WebGL ping-pong: advect, divergence, Jacobi pressure, subtract gradient.

entries.definition: Soft, out-of-focus round lights drifting slowly in the background.
entries.prompt_phrase: 40 orbs, 20-90 px radius, radial gradients at 6-18% opacity, additive, drifting 5 px/s.
entries.pitfalls: High opacity orbs become noise.
entries.native_impl: createRadialGradient circles, globalCompositeOperation='lighter'.

entries.definition: Rendering the whole soundtrack faster than real time into a buffer, then encoding to WAV for muxing.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render 30 s stereo at 48 kHz in an OfflineAudioContext(2, 48000*30, 48000), encode to 16-bit WAV, mux with ffmpeg -c:a aac -b:a 192k.
entries.pitfalls: Using realtime context and screen-recording audio drifts.
entries.native_impl: ctx.startRendering().then(buf => wavEncode(buf)).

entries.definition: A low thump made from a sine whose pitch drops rapidly, with a short amplitude envelope.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sine oscillator 150→45 Hz exponential over 120 ms, gain 1.0→0.001 over 400 ms, plus a 3 ms noise click at -18 dB.
entries.pitfalls: Starting gain at exactly 0 breaks exponential ramps.
entries.native_impl: OscillatorNode + frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime + GainNode.

entries.definition: Deep low-frequency hit felt more than heard, used under major reveals.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sine 55→30 Hz over 900 ms, gain envelope 5 ms attack, 1.6 s exponential decay, plus lowpassed noise at 200 Hz -20 dB.
entries.pitfalls: Phone speakers drop sub; layer a 110 Hz harmonic.
entries.native_impl: Oscillator + WaveShaper light saturation for harmonics.

entries.definition: Filtered noise whose filter cutoff and volume rise into a hit, building anticipation.
entries.prompt_phrase: White noise through bandpass Q 4 sweeping 300→8000 Hz exponentially over 2.0 s, gain -30→-8 dB, cut silent 1 frame before the hit.
entries.pitfalls: Riser not ending exactly at the hit undermines it.
entries.native_impl: AudioBuffer of seeded noise + BiquadFilterNode automation.

entries.definition: Descending filtered noise or pitch that releases tension after a hit.
entries.prompt_phrase: Noise lowpass sweeping 6000→200 Hz over 1.2 s with gain -12→-40 dB, starting on the hit.
entries.pitfalls: Too long muddies the next section.
entries.native_impl: Biquad lowpass frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime.

entries.definition: A short noise sweep with panning that accompanies fast motion on screen.
entries.prompt_phrase: Pink noise, bandpass 800→3000→600 Hz over 350 ms, gain peak -10 dB at 150 ms, pan -0.6→+0.6 matching on-screen direction.
entries.pitfalls: Whoosh on every move becomes clutter.
entries.native_impl: Noise buffer → Biquad → StereoPanner with automation.

entries.definition: A very short high transient confirming a UI interaction.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sine 2400 Hz with 1 ms attack, 25 ms exponential decay, gain -20 dB, plus 2 ms highpassed noise at -28 dB.
entries.pitfalls: Loud ticks are fatiguing; keep under -18 dB.
entries.native_impl: Short OscillatorNode with GainNode envelope.

entries.definition: A short rising pitched blip for elements appearing.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sine sweeping 400→1200 Hz over 60 ms, gain envelope 2 ms attack, 120 ms decay, -16 dB.
entries.best_for: Icons popping in, badges, chat bubbles
entries.pitfalls: Identical pops repeated sound mechanical; vary pitch ±3 semitones seeded.
entries.native_impl: Oscillator frequency ramp + gain envelope.

entries.definition: Sustained chord from several slightly detuned sawtooth oscillators through a lowpass filter.
entries.prompt_phrase: Four-note chord, 3 saw oscillators per note detuned -7/0/+7 cents, lowpass 1200 Hz Q 0.7, attack 1.5 s, release 2 s, -24 dB.
entries.best_for: Background bed under the whole film
entries.pitfalls: Pad too bright masks UI sounds; keep cutoff low.
entries.native_impl: OscillatorNode type 'sawtooth', detune param, BiquadFilter.

entries.definition: Quiet high-pitched sustained partials adding air and sparkle.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sine partials at 2x and 3x chord frequencies, tremolo 5 Hz depth 30%, -32 dB, highpassed at 3 kHz.
entries.pitfalls: Above -26 dB becomes piercing.
entries.native_impl: Oscillators + LFO on gain via second oscillator.

entries.definition: Lowering the bed volume momentarily whenever a hit plays so hits cut through.
entries.prompt_phrase: On each kick, duck pad gain by 8 dB in 10 ms, recover over 250 ms exponential.
entries.pitfalls: Ducking too long causes audible pumping.
entries.native_impl: Schedule gain automation on the pad bus at each cue.

entries.definition: Reverb produced by convolving with an impulse response generated from decaying noise in code.
entries.prompt_phrase: Generate a 2.4 s stereo impulse from seeded noise with exponential decay (RT60 2.4 s), predelay 20 ms, wet -14 dB.
entries.best_for: Space and polish on all sounds
entries.pitfalls: Downloaded impulse responses add licensing risk; generate.
entries.native_impl: ConvolverNode with buffer filled by noise*exp(-t*6.9/RT60).

entries.definition: Repeating echoes of a sound at a tempo-synced interval.
entries.prompt_phrase: Dotted-eighth delay (375 ms at 120 BPM), feedback 0.35, lowpass 3 kHz in the loop, wet -16 dB.
entries.pitfalls: Unsynced delays smear the rhythm.
entries.native_impl: DelayNode with GainNode feedback and Biquad in loop.

entries.definition: A short burst of bandpassed noise, often with several tiny retriggers, used as backbeat.
entries.prompt_phrase: 3 noise bursts 10 ms apart, bandpass 1500 Hz Q 1.5, final decay 180 ms, -12 dB, on beats 2 and 4.
entries.pitfalls: Single burst sounds like static.
entries.native_impl: Noise buffer source with stepped gain automation.

entries.definition: Very short highpassed noise burst providing rhythmic subdivision.
entries.prompt_phrase: Noise highpassed at 7 kHz, 40 ms decay, -22 dB on every eighth note, odd hats 3 dB quieter.
entries.pitfalls: Same velocity every hit sounds programmed.
entries.native_impl: Highpass Biquad + short gain envelope; seeded velocity.

entries.definition: Bell-like tone from frequency modulation with a non-integer ratio.
entries.prompt_phrase: Carrier 880 Hz, modulator ratio 3.5, index 400 Hz decaying to 0 over 1.2 s, amplitude decay 2 s, -18 dB.
entries.pitfalls: High index sounds harsh and metallic.
entries.native_impl: Modulator osc → gain(index) → carrier.frequency.

entries.definition: Short low note with a filter envelope giving a plucky attack.
entries.prompt_phrase: Saw 55-110 Hz, lowpass from 2000→200 Hz over 180 ms, Q 6, amp decay 300 ms, on root notes per bar.
entries.pitfalls: Bass notes clashing with pad chord roots.
entries.native_impl: Oscillator + Biquad frequency envelope.

entries.definition: Notes scheduled from a pattern array against the beat grid.
entries.prompt_phrase: 16-step pattern at 120 BPM sixteenths (125 ms), scale degrees from minor pentatonic, schedule all notes up front in the offline context.
entries.pitfalls: Scheduling with setTimeout is imprecise; use audio-time starts.
entries.native_impl: for each step: osc.start(stepTime) in OfflineAudioContext.

entries.definition: Matching integrated loudness to a delivery target so the film is not too quiet or too loud.
entries.prompt_phrase: Normalize the mix to -14 LUFS integrated with true peak at most -1 dBTP using ffmpeg loudnorm two-pass.
entries.pitfalls: Peaks clipping after AAC encoding.
entries.native_impl: ffmpeg -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 (measure then apply).

entries.definition: A compressor/limiter on the master bus that controls peaks and glues the mix.
entries.prompt_phrase: DynamicsCompressor threshold -6 dB, knee 0, ratio 20, attack 3 ms, release 120 ms, then gain makeup +2 dB.
entries.pitfalls: Heavy limiting flattens hits; keep reduction under 4 dB.
entries.native_impl: DynamicsCompressorNode before destination.

entries.definition: Positioning sounds left-right to match their on-screen origin.
entries.prompt_phrase: Pan each UI sound to its element's x: pan = (x/width)*1.6 - 0.8; keep kick and bass at 0.
entries.pitfalls: Hard-panned sounds vanish on mono phone speakers.
entries.native_impl: StereoPannerNode.pan.setValueAtTime.

entries.definition: Playback pitch and speed drop to zero, like a tape machine stopping, signaling an abrupt halt.
entries.prompt_phrase: Pitch bend the music bus down 24 semitones over 600 ms via playbackRate 1→0.05 exponential, then silence.
entries.pitfalls: Use once per film at most.
entries.native_impl: Render music to buffer; AudioBufferSourceNode.playbackRate ramp.

entries.definition: Cutting all sound for a short moment right before a big hit to maximize contrast.
entries.prompt_phrase: Mute everything for 250 ms (all buses gain to 0 in 10 ms) immediately before the logo hit at 14.0 s.
entries.pitfalls: Clicks from instant mute; ramp over 5-10 ms.
entries.native_impl: Master gain automation with short ramps.

entries.definition: A striking image or motion in the first second that stops scrolling before any branding.
entries.prompt_phrase: Frame 0 already shows motion: the hero shape is mid-transform at 40% scale, high contrast; first readable words by 0.8 s; no logo before 2 s.
entries.pitfalls: Starting with a fade from black or a logo loses viewers.
entries.native_impl: Timeline begins mid-action; QA frame 0 thumbnail.

entries.definition: Three-beat micro-story: hook, one proof, branded close.
entries.prompt_phrase: 0-2 s hook, 2-10 s single demo or claim with one supporting visual, 10-13 s tagline, 13-15 s end card with logo and CTA.
entries.pitfalls: Cramming three features into 15 s.
entries.native_impl: Cue sheet with 4 sections; total 450 frames at 30 fps.

entries.definition: Four-act arc: hook, problem or context, solution with 2-3 features, close.
entries.prompt_phrase: 0-3 s hook, 3-8 s problem, 8-22 s solution with 3 feature beats of about 4.5 s each, 22-26 s tagline, 26-30 s end card.
entries.pitfalls: Problem beat longer than 6 s drags.
entries.native_impl: Sections on 4-bar phrases at 120 BPM (8 s) adjusted to beats.

entries.definition: Fuller arc with setup, escalation, demo sequences, emotional peak and close.
entries.prompt_phrase: 0-4 s hook, 4-14 s world and problem, 14-40 s three demo chapters of about 8.5 s, 40-50 s montage crescendo, 50-55 s tagline, 55-60 s end card.
entries.pitfalls: Flat energy; plan a rise and peak at 70-85%.
entries.native_impl: Cue sheet with chapters; energy curve keyed to music sections.

entries.definition: One idea, one visual, one brand mark in six seconds.
entries.prompt_phrase: 0-1 s motion hook, 1-4.5 s single message line held at least 2 s, 4.5-6 s logo lockup.
entries.pitfalls: More than 8 words total.
entries.native_impl: 180 frames at 30 fps, 3 cues.

entries.definition: Shows the friction or limit the product solves, in visual terms rather than words.
entries.prompt_phrase: Show the clutter: 14 overlapping windows cascade in at 40 ms stagger, desaturated 60%, slight 0.5° jitter, for 3.5 s.
entries.pitfalls: Mocking competitors or naming them.
entries.native_impl: Cool grade and denser motion than solution acts.

entries.definition: The single moment the film flips from problem to solution, usually marked visually and sonically.
entries.prompt_phrase: At 8.0 s: pre-hit silence 250 ms, all clutter collapses to one point in 300 ms inExpo, grade warms over 600 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Gradual turns feel uncertain; make it one frame-accurate event.
entries.native_impl: Cue 'turn' drives visual collapse and audio hit.

entries.definition: The first clear look at the product or core idea, given space and time.
entries.prompt_phrase: Product emerges from darkness via rim light over 1.5 s, camera dollies in 6%, hold 2 s with idle float.
entries.pitfalls: Revealing during busy motion steals the moment.
entries.native_impl: Lighting intensity keys plus camera track.

entries.definition: Exactly three features, each with one visual and one short line, in a consistent template.
entries.prompt_phrase: Three feature beats of 4.0 s each: 0.5 s title in, 3 s demo, 0.5 s transition; same layout and motion for all three.
entries.pitfalls: Changing layout per feature makes it feel unplanned.
entries.native_impl: Feature array mapped through one scene function.

entries.definition: A number, comparison or demo that makes the claim believable.
entries.prompt_phrase: Hero stat '3.2x faster' counts up over 1.2 s outExpo, before-after bars grow beneath, hold 2 s.
entries.pitfalls: Unsubstantiated numbers; use the client's real figures only.
entries.native_impl: Data-viz components with cue-driven timing.

entries.definition: Showing the product doing one real task from start to finish.
entries.prompt_phrase: Single uncut 5 s UI sequence: cursor clicks, panel opens 300 ms, result fills 800 ms, success check at 4.2 s.
entries.pitfalls: Cutting mid-task hides the payoff.
entries.native_impl: Scripted UI timeline with cursor cues.

entries.definition: Accelerating sequence of quick shots building to the climax.
entries.prompt_phrase: 8 shots shortening from 1.0 s to 0.25 s on beats, scale and brightness rising 5% per shot, landing on the hero at the downbeat.
entries.pitfalls: Montage without visual throughline feels random.
entries.native_impl: Geometric durations snapped to beat grid.

entries.definition: The key line of the film appears alone, with silence or a sustained chord.
entries.prompt_phrase: Tagline enters with baseline mask rise, 60 ms word stagger, 520 ms outExpo, holds 2.5 s on near-black.
entries.pitfalls: Tagline sharing frame with busy visuals.
entries.native_impl: Dedicated typography scene.

entries.definition: Final held frame with logo, product name, CTA and date or URL.
entries.prompt_phrase: Logo centered at 47% height, 22% frame width; CTA line 40% below logo in 32 px; holds at least 3 s, last 0.5 s static.
entries.pitfalls: Animated elements still moving on the last frame.
entries.native_impl: Static layout; motion fully settles by -2.5 s.

entries.definition: One clear instruction telling the viewer what to do next.
entries.prompt_phrase: CTA 'Available today' fades and rises 12 px over 400 ms at end-card +0.6 s, accent underline draws 300 ms later.
entries.pitfalls: Multiple CTAs dilute response.
entries.native_impl: Typography track within end card.

entries.definition: A short, consistent animated logo reveal with a signature sound.
entries.prompt_phrase: Logo builds from 3 strokes drawing on in 600 ms, fill snaps at 700 ms with kick and FM chime, total 1.5 s.
entries.pitfalls: Different logo animation in each film weakens recognition.
entries.native_impl: Reusable function logoSting(t) shared across films.

entries.definition: Film's last frame flows perfectly into its first for looping platforms.
entries.prompt_phrase: All periodic motions use periods dividing 10 s exactly; frame 299 to frame 0 differ by under 1% pixel delta.
entries.pitfalls: Drift from non-divisible periods creates a pop at the loop.
entries.native_impl: Periods = 10/n s; QA diff first and last frames.

entries.definition: Structuring the story to work fully without audio, since many feeds autoplay muted.
entries.prompt_phrase: Every claim appears as on-screen text at least 48 px at 1080 wide; audio only reinforces, never carries information.
entries.pitfalls: Key info existing only in sound.
entries.native_impl: QA by watching a muted render.

entries.definition: The closing shot echoes the opening shot, changed to show transformation.
entries.prompt_phrase: Open on a gray circle at center 20% frame width; close on the same circle in brand color at the same position and size.
entries.best_for: Emotional closure in 30 and 60 s films
entries.pitfalls: Echo too subtle to notice.
entries.native_impl: Shared anchor constants for first and last shots.

entries.definition: Showing only fragments of the product to build curiosity before a full reveal.
entries.prompt_phrase: Show only 15% of the product at a time via rim light slivers across 3 shots of 1.5 s, full reveal never shown, date card last.
entries.pitfalls: Revealing too much removes curiosity.
entries.native_impl: Lighting masks restrict visible region.

entries.definition: Film organized as a numbered sequence leading to a reveal.
entries.prompt_phrase: Numbers 5 to 1, one per beat at 120 BPM (500 ms each), each slamming 1.6x→1.0x in 150 ms, reveal on the next downbeat.
entries.pitfalls: Inconsistent timing between numbers.
entries.native_impl: Number cues on beat grid.

entries.definition: Planned rise and fall of visual and audio intensity across the film.
entries.prompt_phrase: Energy curve on a 0-10 scale: hook 7, problem 4, turn 8, features 6-7, crescendo 9 at 75% of runtime, end card 3.
entries.pitfalls: Constant maximum energy exhausts viewers.
entries.native_impl: Energy array drives cut rate, motion amplitude and mix level.

entries.definition: Every frame is a pure function of its frame index, so re-rendering gives identical pixels.
entries.prompt_phrase: Drive all animation from t = frame/30; ban Date.now, performance.now and Math.random; render frame 137 twice and require 0 differing pixels.
entries.pitfalls: Wall-clock timers or async asset loads change frames.
entries.native_impl: window.renderFrame(n) sets t=n/fps, draws, resolves after GPU finish.

entries.definition: Simulations advance with constant steps from frame 0, never by measured elapsed time.
entries.prompt_phrase: Step physics at dt = 1/120 s, 4 substeps per 30 fps frame; to render frame n, simulate from 0 or from cached checkpoints every 30 frames.
entries.pitfalls: Seeking to a frame without simulating the steps before it.
entries.native_impl: Checkpoint state snapshots; replay from nearest.

entries.definition: Verifying the last frame flows into the first with no jump.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render frames N-1, 0 and 1; mean absolute pixel difference N-1→0 must be within 20% of the 0→1 difference.
entries.pitfalls: Checking only visually at full speed misses small pops.
entries.native_impl: Node/py script diffs PNGs, prints mean delta.

entries.definition: A grid of frames sampled across the film viewed as one image to judge rhythm, composition and consistency.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sample 1 frame every 0.5 s into a 10-column contact sheet at 320 px wide per frame; review for repetition, empty frames and off-palette colors.
entries.best_for: Reviewing a whole film at a glance
entries.pitfalls: Sampling too sparsely misses short glitches.
entries.native_impl: ffmpeg -vf fps=2,scale=320:-1,tile=10x6.

entries.definition: Minimum text size and hold time that remains readable when viewed on a phone.
entries.prompt_phrase: Body text at least 3.5% of frame height (38 px at 1080p), headlines at least 6%; check at 360 px wide downscale.
entries.pitfalls: Designing at full screen on a monitor only.
entries.native_impl: Layout lint: font px / frame height ratio.

entries.definition: Measuring luminance contrast between text and its actual rendered background.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sample the rendered background behind each text box; require contrast at least 4.5:1 for body and 3:1 for 48 px+ headlines.
entries.pitfalls: Checking against intended color, not actual pixels.
entries.native_impl: Compute relative luminance from sampled pixels; (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05).

entries.definition: Automated check that text and key elements do not overlap each other unintentionally on any frame.
entries.prompt_phrase: Every 5th frame, export bounding boxes of all text and logos; flag any intersection over 2% of the smaller box area.
entries.pitfalls: Checking only the held frames, not transitions.
entries.native_impl: Scene exposes getBoxes(t); rect intersection test.

entries.definition: Viewing the film at real phone size to judge readability and focus.
entries.prompt_phrase: Downscale to 360x640 (9:16) or 640x360 (16:9) and view at 100%; every line must be readable and the focal point obvious within 1 s.
entries.pitfalls: Fine lines and small text disappearing.
entries.native_impl: ffmpeg scale filter; review stills at 1x.

entries.definition: Rendering debug frames with safe-area and platform UI guides to verify placement.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render 6 key frames with 5% title-safe box and 9:16 platform zones (bottom 20%, right 12%) drawn at 30% red; zero text inside zones.
entries.pitfalls: Leaving guides on in the final render.
entries.native_impl: DEBUG flag draws guides; off for final.

entries.definition: Verifying audio hits align with visual events to the frame.
entries.prompt_phrase: For each cue, compare audio onset (energy rise above -30 dB) to the visual event frame; tolerance ±1 frame at 30 fps.
entries.pitfalls: AAC encoder priming offsets audio by about 21 ms; check post-mux.
entries.native_impl: Onset detection on WAV; compare to cue sheet.

entries.definition: Inspecting smooth gradients after encoding for visible stepped bands.
entries.prompt_phrase: Encode a test clip at the delivery bitrate, crop dark gradient regions, boost contrast 4x and look for steps wider than 20 px.
entries.pitfalls: Judging banding only on the lossless master.
entries.native_impl: ffmpeg eq=contrast=4 on cropped region.

entries.definition: Waiting for all fonts to be loaded before rendering any frame, so fallback fonts never appear.
entries.prompt_phrase: Await document.fonts.load for every family and weight used, then document.fonts.ready; render frame 0 only after document.fonts.check passes for 100% of specs.
entries.pitfalls: First frames rendering with fallback font.
entries.native_impl: await Promise.all(specs.map(s => document.fonts.load(s))).

entries.definition: Confirming every font used is under the Open Font License (OFL) or written in code.
entries.prompt_phrase: List every font file used with its license text; 100% must be Open Font License (OFL); embed files locally, no runtime CDN loads.
entries.pitfalls: System fonts and unlicensed files slipping in.
entries.native_impl: Manifest of fonts with license field; build fails otherwise.

entries.definition: Automatic detection of unintended black or empty frames.
entries.prompt_phrase: Run ffmpeg blackdetect with pixel threshold 0.08 and minimum duration 0.05 s; any hit outside planned dips fails.
entries.pitfalls: Async draw errors leaving blank frames.
entries.native_impl: ffmpeg -vf blackdetect=d=0.05:pix_th=0.08 -f null -.

entries.definition: Fixed encoding settings that play everywhere and preserve quality.
entries.prompt_phrase: H.264 High profile, yuv420p, CRF 16, preset slow, 30 fps constant, bt709 tags, +faststart; AAC 192 kb/s 48 kHz.
entries.pitfalls: yuv444p or 10-bit files fail on many players.
entries.native_impl: ffmpeg -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart.

entries.definition: Verifying each output frame is unique and evenly spaced, with no stutters or repeats.
entries.prompt_phrase: Compute per-frame difference; flag any consecutive pair with 0 difference during motion, and confirm count equals duration x 30.
entries.pitfalls: Capture timing issues produce duplicated frames.
entries.native_impl: ffmpeg mpdecimate dry-run or PNG hash comparison.

entries.definition: Rendering and inspecting stills at the most important moments as images before full renders.
entries.prompt_phrase: Render PNG stills at each cue time plus 0.5 s after; view each as an image and check composition, type, contrast and brand color.
entries.pitfalls: Reviewing only during motion hides layout bugs.
entries.native_impl: Harness renderFrame at cue frames, screenshot to PNG.

entries.definition: Viewing frames in grayscale to confirm hierarchy and separation without color.
entries.prompt_phrase: Convert key frames to grayscale; focal element must be at least 30 L* points brighter or darker than its surroundings.
entries.pitfalls: Separation relying on hue alone.
entries.native_impl: ffmpeg -vf format=gray or canvas luminance.

entries.definition: Ensuring flashes and rapid contrast changes stay below seizure-risk thresholds.
entries.prompt_phrase: No more than 3 full-frame luminance flashes per second; flagged when mean luminance swings over 10% and back within 333 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Rapid red flashes are especially risky.
entries.native_impl: Per-frame mean luminance series; count transitions in sliding 1 s window.

entries.definition: Comparing new renders against approved stills to catch unintended changes.
entries.prompt_phrase: After every code change, re-render 8 approved frames; flag any frame with more than 0.5% pixels differing by over 8/255.
entries.pitfalls: Allowing nondeterminism makes diffs meaningless.
entries.native_impl: PNG diff script with threshold.

entries.definition: Measuring the final mix for clipping and loudness against target.
entries.prompt_phrase: Measure the muxed file: true peak at most -1.0 dBTP, integrated loudness -14 ±1 LUFS, no samples at full scale.
entries.pitfalls: Checking the WAV but not the encoded AAC.
entries.native_impl: ffmpeg -af ebur128=peak=true -f null -.

entries.definition: Extracting every rendered string to check spelling, wording and forbidden content.
entries.prompt_phrase: Log every fillText string and SVG text node with its first and last frame; require 0 spelling errors, 0 placeholder strings and 0 disallowed names.
entries.best_for: Catching typos and accidental placeholder text
entries.pitfalls: Text baked into paths escapes logging.
entries.native_impl: Wrap fillText to record strings during a dry run.

entries.definition: Every element simply fades from 0 to 1 at center; the most common sign of default machine-made motion.
entries.prompt_phrase: Replace opacity-only entrances with masked rises: 32 px travel from a baseline mask, 500 ms outExpo, opacity reaching 1 within the first 200 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Swapping fades for one other universal preset.
entries.native_impl: Per-element entrance types chosen by role.

entries.definition: Moves start and stop at full speed, looking mechanical.
entries.prompt_phrase: Ban linear on any move that starts or stops on screen; use outCubic 400-600 ms for entrances and inCubic 250-350 ms for exits.
entries.pitfalls: Linear remains correct for continuous scrolls and spins.
entries.native_impl: Lint timeline: flag linear tracks whose endpoints are on screen.

entries.definition: Every group in the film uses the same stagger and duration, making motion monotonous.
entries.prompt_phrase: Vary stagger by role: letters 20-30 ms, words 60-90 ms, cards 50 ms, grid items by distance 15 ms/unit; group totals 300-900 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Random staggers per run break determinism.
entries.native_impl: Stagger table keyed by element type.

entries.definition: A saturated violet-to-blue diagonal gradient used regardless of brand.
entries.prompt_phrase: Derive background from the brand palette: two OKLCH stops within 25° hue of the primary, chroma under 0.06, lightness 0.14-0.22.
entries.best_for: Any film without explicit brand colors
entries.pitfalls: Replacing with another trendy gradient.
entries.native_impl: Palette generator from brand hex.

entries.definition: Bloom and outer glows applied to every element so nothing stands out.
entries.prompt_phrase: Restrict glow to one emissive element per shot; bloom threshold 0.9, intensity under 0.25; text gets zero glow.
entries.pitfalls: Removing all glow makes emissives look dead.
entries.native_impl: Emissive mask channel; bloom only from mask.

entries.definition: Generic drifting dots-and-lines network used as background filler with no meaning.
entries.prompt_phrase: Replace with a background derived from the story: e.g. 3 slow brand-colored gradient fields at 0.05 Hz, or remove it and use negative space.
entries.pitfalls: Swapping in another unmotivated particle loop.
entries.native_impl: Background chosen per scene from the story beat.

entries.definition: Particles float over or behind text without reacting, cluttering and reducing contrast.
entries.prompt_phrase: Particles must avoid text: repulsor radius 1.3x text box, max opacity 15% within 100 px of text, and react to cue hits with a 20% speed pulse.
entries.pitfalls: Particles crossing over glyphs.
entries.native_impl: Signed distance to text boxes feeds repulsion.

entries.definition: Bouncy or elastic easing on data, pricing or enterprise messaging, undermining credibility.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use critically damped springs (stiffness 170, damping 26) or outCubic for data and text; reserve outBack(1.2) for at most 2 icon accents.
entries.pitfalls: Removing all overshoot makes UI feel stiff.
entries.native_impl: Easing whitelist per element role.

entries.definition: Shake added for energy without a corresponding impact.
entries.prompt_phrase: Only shake on a scripted impact cue: 4-6 px amplitude, 18 Hz seeded noise, exponential decay to 0 in 250 ms.
entries.pitfalls: Constant jitter over held text.
entries.native_impl: Shake envelope keyed to hit cues.

entries.definition: Every shot slowly scales up regardless of content, a filler move that signals no idea.
entries.prompt_phrase: Give each shot one motivated move chosen from the shot list: truck, orbit, rack focus or locked-off; at most 2 consecutive shots may push in.
entries.pitfalls: Replacing with equally constant drift.
entries.native_impl: Shot list enumerates camera move per shot.

entries.definition: Multiple bright flares and streaks without a light source in frame.
entries.prompt_phrase: Allow at most 1 flare per film, only from a visible light source, streak 30% frame width at 25% opacity, lasting under 1 s.
entries.pitfalls: Flares crossing text.
entries.native_impl: Flare drawn only when light screen position on-frame.

entries.definition: Fake Latin filler, generic names or '1,234' sample numbers left in UI or titles.
entries.prompt_phrase: Every string must come from the approved copy deck; UI mockups use 6-12 realistic, product-relevant lines; QA scan returns 0 placeholder strings.
entries.pitfalls: Inventing fake statistics as claims.
entries.native_impl: Text content audit with banned-pattern regex.

entries.definition: Text rendered in whatever default sans-serif the browser picks because no font was specified or loaded.
entries.prompt_phrase: Load one OFL display family and one OFL text family locally; set explicit weights (e.g. 600 headline, 400 body) and tracking -2% above 96 px.
entries.pitfalls: Fonts loading after frame 0 renders fallback.
entries.native_impl: @font-face with local files + font load gate.

entries.definition: Text #FFFFFF on #000000 with no tonal nuance, causing glare and encode blocking.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use text #F2F4F7 on #0B0D10; secondary text at 64% opacity; keep contrast at least 12:1.
entries.pitfalls: Lowering contrast below legibility thresholds.
entries.native_impl: Palette tokens instead of literal black/white.

entries.definition: All elements animate simultaneously, so the eye has no entry point.
entries.prompt_phrase: Sequence by hierarchy: headline first at 0 ms, visual at 200 ms, supporting text at 450 ms; at most 3 primary motions active per frame.
entries.pitfalls: Over-sequencing makes scenes slow.
entries.native_impl: Motion density counter in QA.

entries.definition: Every shot lasts the same duration, giving a flat, mechanical rhythm.
entries.prompt_phrase: Vary shot lengths on the beat grid in long-short-short patterns (e.g. 2.0, 1.0, 1.0 s), and give the hero shot at least 2x the average.
entries.pitfalls: Random lengths off the beat grid.
entries.native_impl: Duration pattern array snapped to beats.

entries.definition: Chromatic glitch and slice transitions used as generic 'tech' energy.
entries.prompt_phrase: Replace with a motivated transition: match cut or push 550 ms inOutExpo; allow glitch only for a story beat about errors, max 6 frames.
entries.pitfalls: Swapping glitch for another stock-looking preset.
entries.native_impl: Transition chosen from shot relationship.

entries.definition: Every card is a frosted translucent panel, reducing contrast and readability.
entries.prompt_phrase: Use frosted glass for at most 1 surface per shot; other cards solid #1C222B with 1 px 10% white hairline; text contrast stays at least 4.5:1.
entries.pitfalls: Glass panels over low-contrast backgrounds become gray mush.
entries.native_impl: Material assignment per element role.

entries.definition: A rotating wireframe planet used to mean 'global' with no specific data.
entries.prompt_phrase: Show specific places instead: 3-5 labeled points on a flat custom-drawn map with route traces, or remove the globe beat entirely.
entries.pitfalls: Using third-party map tiles or imagery.
entries.native_impl: Vector map paths authored in code.

entries.definition: Star and sparkle glyphs scattered to imply magic or intelligence.
entries.prompt_phrase: Remove decorative sparkles; express capability through a concrete before-after demo of 3-5 s showing the actual output.
entries.pitfalls: Replacing sparkles with another meaningless motif.
entries.native_impl: Demo scene instead of decor layer.

entries.definition: A single repeating music loop with no hits, whooshes or UI sounds synced to picture.
entries.prompt_phrase: Score from the cue sheet: pad bed at -24 dB, kick on every downbeat cut, whoosh on each push, UI tick on each click, 250 ms silence before the logo hit.
entries.pitfalls: Sound effects on every frame clutter the mix.
entries.native_impl: OfflineAudioContext built from the same CUES object.

entries.definition: Film ends on a moving frame or cuts to black mid-motion.
entries.prompt_phrase: All motion settles at least 2.5 s before the end; final 0.5 s fully static; audio tail fades -60 dB by the last frame.
entries.pitfalls: Long empty black tail after the end card.
entries.native_impl: Assert zero motion tracks active in final 15 frames.
